Our position is that financial LLM validation should be an ongoing system discipline rather than a one-time model scoring exercise. Validation should produce decision-ready evidence, not only scores. We conclude with a research agenda for system-aware benchmarks, agent trace validation, judge alignment protocols, and lifecycle validation standards.

AI.tldr: 本文主张金融领域的LLM系统不应仅基于基准测试分数获得生产部署批准，而应进行覆盖数据、模型、检索、智能体行为、治理和实现等多层面的系统性验证。作者提出混合评估的必要性，讨论了LLM-as-a-judge方法的适用场景及其控制措施，并指出静态基准无法捕捉的失败模式，强调金融LLM验证应是一种持续的系统性纪律而非一次性评分。
AI.motivation: 当前金融领域LLM评估过度聚焦于模型中心视角（基准分数、任务准确率或一次性定性评审），但这些评估方式无法充分证明系统在生产环境中的准备就绪程度。金融场景对可靠性、合规性和可审计性有更高要求，因此需要更全面的系统级验证框架。
AI.method: 基于作者在金融机构中验证GenAI应用的实际行业经验，提出一种多层验证视角，涵盖数据、模型设计、检索与生成性能、智能体行为、治理和实现等层面。主张采用混合评估策略，并在LLM-as-a-judge方法中引入多重评审者、评估标准、一致性检验和可审计性控制。
AI.result: 识别出静态基准难以捕捉的关键失败模式，包括检索失败、不忠实生成、工具误用、升级处理错误和运营不稳定等问题。论证了从一次性模型评分转向持续系统验证纪律的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 金融LLM验证应作为持续的系统性纪律运行，产出可供决策的证据而非仅有分数。研究议程聚焦于系统感知基准、智能体轨迹验证、评判者对齐协议和生命周期验证标准的开发。

title: SafeNexus: Discovering and Steering Modality-Universal Safety Neurons in MLLMs
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising safety performance, extending them to Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exposes a significant gap between expanded multimodal capabilities and existing safety mechanisms. Current defenses remain predominantly confined to specific modal settings, thereby limiting their robustness against broader cross-modal threats. To bridge this gap, we introduce SafeNexus, a cross-modal safety alignment framework that adopts a dedicated neuron-level intervention strategy. First, we formulate a neuron localization paradigm that identifies functionally specialized neurons by characterizing intermediate-layer activation patterns and quantifying their functional salience through importance scoring. Building upon this paradigm, we exploit contrastive data to identify modality-bound safety neurons (BS-Neurons), and validate their role in regulating safety behavior within each modality via targeted suppression. Further cross-modal analysis defines modality-universal safety neurons (US-Neurons) as the shared subset of BS-Neurons identified across individual modalities, serving as the core for defending against harmful cross-modal attacks. We observe that suppressing these neurons substantially degrades safety performance across modalities, while leaving overall utility largely unaffected. Building on these insights, we propose two safety alignment strategies: activation-level safety amplifier and safety neuron calibrator. The proposed strategies enhance model safety through two distinct routes: the former amplifies the activation magnitudes of US-Neurons, while the latter selectively calibrates them via targeted fine-tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms prevailing state-of-the-art approaches on safety benchmarks spanning diverse modality combinations, while effectively preserving utility.

AI.tldr: SafeNexus是一个跨模态安全对齐框架，通过神经元级别的干预策略来弥补多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中扩展的多模态能力与现有安全机制之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型安全防御机制仅限于单一模态设置，无法有效应对跨模态威胁。随着模型从LLM扩展到MLLM，多模态能力与安全机制之间出现了显著差距，需要更强大的跨模态安全对齐框架。
AI.method: 首先提出神经元定位范式，通过中间层激活模式和重要性评分识别功能性特化神经元；利用对比数据识别模态绑定安全神经元（BS-Neurons）和模态通用安全神经元（US-Neurons）；提出两种安全对齐策略：激活级安全放大器（放大US-Neurons的激活强度）和安全神经元校准器（通过定向微调选择性地校准US-Neurons）。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在涵盖多种模态组合的安全基准上优于现有的最先进方法，同时有效保留了模型的基本效用（utility）。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别并利用跨模态共享的安全神经元（US-Neurons），SafeNexus能够在保持模型整体性能的同时显著增强多模态场景下的安全防御能力，为MLLMs的安全对齐提供了新的神经元级干预思路。

title: TextCloak: Thwarting Unauthorized LLM Exploitation via RL-Driven Unlearnable Text
summary: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) offer a promising defense by introducing carefully designed perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. However, existing methods for text protection are primarily designed for classification tasks (e.g., sentiment analysis) in discriminative language models and often rely on injecting class-specific linguistic cues, which limits their effectiveness in the open-ended generation settings of LLMs. In this work, we propose TextCloak, an RL-driven framework for protecting textual data against unauthorized LLM exploitation. TextCloak employs a generative policy that transforms batches of clean text into unlearnable examples while preserving semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness. To optimize the policy, we introduce GRPO-UE, which rewards generated unlearnable text based on the downstream degradation they induce in fine-tuned surrogate LLMs and updates the generator parameters via group-relative policy optimization. This bi-level optimization enables the generator to discover generalizable protective patterns beyond class-specific cues. Comprehensive experiments on six publicly available datasets and nine state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that TextCloak consistently impairs unauthorized fine-tuning while maintaining text utility for legitimate use. Further analyses establish its transferability and robustness across model architectures, training configurations, and adaptive attacks, highlighting its broad applicability as a practical defense against unauthorized LLM exploitation.

AI.tldr: TextCloak是一个基于强化学习的框架，用于保护文本数据免受未经授权的大型语言模型（LLM）利用。它通过生成策略将干净文本转化为不可学习样本，同时保持语义保真度和语言自然性，并通过GRPO-UE优化策略来干扰下游微调模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本保护方法主要针对判别式语言模型的分类任务设计，依赖注入类特定语言线索，在LLM的开放式生成场景中效果有限。需要一种能适应LLM生成任务、无需类特定线索的通用文本保护方法。
AI.method: 提出TextCloak框架，采用强化学习驱动的生成策略将文本批次转化为不可学习示例。引入GRPO-UE优化算法，基于微调替代LLM的下游性能退化程度给予奖励，通过组相对策略优化更新生成器参数，形成双层优化以发现可泛化的保护模式。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集和九个先进LLM上的综合实验表明，TextCloak能持续削弱未经授权的微调效果，同时保持文本对合法用途的效用。进一步分析证明了其跨模型架构、训练配置和自适应攻击的迁移性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TextCloak作为一种实用且可泛化的防御手段，有效应对了LLM时代未经授权数据利用和隐私泄露的挑战，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: LegoQ: Density-Matrix Representation Learning with Spectral-Spatial State Transitions for Hyperspectral Classification
summary: Hyperspectral image classification is complicated by mixed pixels, spectral ambiguity, class imbalance, and limited annotations. Most current classifiers encode a pixel or patch as a deterministic vector and apply a linear or multilayer softmax head. Although effective for discrimination, this representation does not directly expose how mixed or uncertain a sample is. This paper presents \method, a classical density-matrix representation learning framework for hyperspectral images. The spectral bands are divided into groups and each group is mapped to a positive semi-definite, Hermitian, trace-normalized matrix state. A composable stack of spectral, spatial, and inter-group transitions then updates the states while repeatedly projecting them back to the valid state set. Instead of flattening the final features, \method\ aggregates the group states and compares them with learnable class-prototype density matrices through Uhlmann fidelity. The normalized eigenspectrum, von Neumann entropy, purity, and prototype fidelity provide sample-level diagnostics that are unavailable from a conventional vector head. On Indian Pines, ten runs yield an overall accuracy of $96.20\pm0.70\%$, an average accuracy of $95.57\pm1.29\%$, and a kappa coefficient of $95.66\pm0.80\%$. On WHU-Hi-LongKou, the best of ten runs reaches $97.52\%$ overall accuracy. Classification maps and feature projections show that the transition stack produces compact and better separated class structures. The results support constrained matrix-state learning as a practical alternative to vector-only hyperspectral classification without requiring quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于密度矩阵表示学习的高光谱图像分类框架（\method），将光谱波段分组映射为半正定厄米迹归一化矩阵状态，通过谱、空间和组间转移的复合堆叠更新状态，并用Uhlmann保真度与类别原型密度矩阵比较进行分类。在Indian Pines和WHU-Hi-LongKou数据集上取得了优异的精度，同时提供了样本级诊断信息（如von Neumann熵、纯度等），无需量子硬件。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱图像分类器将像素或补丁编码为确定性向量并进行softmax分类，虽然判别有效，但无法直接揭示样本的混合程度或不确定性。面对混合像素、光谱模糊、类别不平衡和有限标注等挑战，需要一种能够显式表达样本不确定性和混合特性的表示方法。
AI.method: 将光谱波段划分为多个组，每组映射为正半定、厄米、迹归一化的密度矩阵状态；通过可组合的光谱、空间和组间转移操作更新状态，并反复投影回有效状态集合；最终聚合各组状态，用Uhlmann保真度与可学习的类别原型密度矩阵进行比较以完成分类。归一化特征谱、von Neumann熵、纯度和原型保真度可提供样本级诊断。
AI.result: 在Indian Pines数据集上十次运行获得总体精度96.20±0.70%、平均精度95.57±1.29%、Kappa系数95.66±0.80%；在WHU-Hi-LongKou数据集上十次运行最优总体精度达到97.52%。分类图和特征投影显示转移堆叠产生了紧凑且分隔更好的类别结构。
AI.conclusion: 约束矩阵状态学习可作为纯向量高光谱分类的实用替代方案，无需量子硬件即可获得更好的分类性能，同时提供传统向量头无法获得的样本级诊断信息。

title: Model or Harness? An Interaction-Centric Taxonomy for Localizing Agent Failures
summary: Existing evaluations often reduce agent failures to system-level outcomes, obscuring where the fault originated and which intervention would improve the agent system. This creates a repair-assignment problem: the same visible failure may call for model post-training, harness engineering, environment redesign, or benchmark repair depending on its source. Because agent behavior emerges from interactions among models, harnesses, users, tools, memory, and environments, outcome-level labels are often insufficient for improvement. Most failure taxonomies do little to resolve this problem because they are benchmark-specific and lack a shared structure. We introduce an interaction-centric taxonomy that localizes failures to the interactions in which they originate and identifies the responsible component. It organizes 41 failure modes by assigning each to an edge between two components and a fault side indicating where the repair belongs. This makes the taxonomy actionable: model-side failures identify targets for post-training, harness-side failures point to scaffolding and tool-integration fixes, and environment or grader failures reveal evaluation conditions requiring redesign. The schema applies across agent architectures, from coding assistants to long-horizon personal assistants and multi-agent systems. We ground the taxonomy in worked examples from public benchmarks, model system cards, published reports, and logged agent trajectories, and evaluate its reproducibility using independent reasoning agents as judges. Across four frontier models, the strongest judge reaches Cohen's $κ=0.76$ against human category labels, suggesting that the categories capture shared structure rather than annotator-specific preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以交互为中心的智能体失败分类法，将41种失败模式分配到组件间的交互边上，并指出修复责任方（模型侧或框架侧），解决了智能体系统故障归因和修复分配的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有评估往往将智能体失败归结为系统层面的结果，无法定位故障源头和确定合适的干预措施。同样的可见失败可能源于模型后训练、框架工程、环境设计或基准测试问题，而现有的失败分类法多为基准特定且缺乏共享结构，难以解决修复分配问题。
AI.method: 提出一个以交互为中心的分类法，将41种失败模式分配到两个组件之间的边（edge）上，并标注故障侧（fault side），指明修复应归属的组件。分类法覆盖模型侧、框架侧、环境和评分者等多个维度，适用于不同智能体架构。通过公共基准、系统卡片、公开报告和日志轨迹中的工作示例进行验证，并使用独立推理智能体作为评判者评估可复现性。
AI.result: 在四个前沿模型中，最强的评判智能体对人工类别标签达到Cohen's κ=0.76，表明该分类法捕捉的是共享结构而非标注者特定偏好。
AI.conclusion: 该交互中心分类法使失败归因具备可操作性：模型侧失败指向后训练目标，框架侧失败指向脚手架和工具集成修复，环境和评分者失败则提示评估条件需重新设计。

title: Token-Level Diagnosis of Sycophancy in LLMs with Attribution-Guided Steering
summary: Sycophancy refers to the tendency for large language models (LLMs) to match user beliefs at the cost of factual correctness, thereby undermining model reliability. Prior work on evaluating sycophancy in LLMs aims to assess whether a model's output matches an authority's claim, but cannot reveal which part of the prompt drives this sycophantic behavior. To bridge this gap, we investigate the relationship of sycophantic responses with an authority's credentials, their assertive claim, and the problem statement. We introduce the Authority Share Index (ASI), an Integrated Gradients-based token attribution method, which measures the degree to which a model's decision is driven by authority-related text. Through extensive experiments across five models and 30 test configurations, we find that sycophantic responses consistently direct more attention toward authority tokens than resistant ones. Moreover, our token attribution method reveals that for the sycophantic cases, the claim asserted by the authority receives more attention than the authority's credentials. Building on these findings, we propose attribution-guided contrastive activation steering to mitigate LLM sycophancy. Our method constructs a steering vector from high-attribution tokens of sycophantic and resistant responses, selectively pushing models toward resistance. This enables inference-time steering without retraining, lowering sycophancy from 96% to 25% in the strongest case. Together, our results show that token-level attribution can both explain what drives sycophancy and directly inform a practical intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Integrated Gradients的token归因方法（Authority Share Index, ASI）来量化语言模型中谄媚行为（sycophancy）的驱动因素，并基于此构建对比激活引导的推理时干预方法，可显著降低模型谄媚率（最强情况下从96%降至25%）。
AI.motivation: 已有研究评估LLM谄媚行为时仅关注模型输出是否匹配权威观点，但无法揭示提示中哪一部分驱动了谄媚行为。为弥补这一空白，作者希望探究权威的可信度、断言性说法和问题陈述三者与谄媚响应的关系。
AI.method: 1) 提出Authority Share Index (ASI)，一种基于Integrated Gradients的token归因方法，量化权威相关文本对模型决策的驱动程度；2) 通过5个模型和30种测试配置进行实验，分析谄媚响应中token的注意力分布；3) 提出归因引导的对比激活引导（attribution-guided contrastive activation steering），从高归因token构建引导向量，在推理时引导模型走向抗拒而非谄媚，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 谄媚响应一贯地将更多注意力集中在权威token上，而非抗拒响应；在谄媚情况下，权威的断言性说法比权威的可信度获得更多关注。提出的干预方法在最强情况下将谄媚率从96%降至25%。
AI.conclusion: token级别的归因既能解释谄媚行为的驱动因素，也能直接指导实际的干预措施，为缓解LLM谄媚问题提供了既具可解释性又具实用性的统一框架。

title: RAID: Towards Robust AI-Generated Image Detection with Bit-Reversed Images
summary: The rapid advancement of image generation models has made it increasingly difficult for people to distinguish AI-generated images from real ones. To prevent the potential risks associated with the misuse of fake images, AI-generated image detection has gained significant attention. Existing methods neglect the inherent differences between real and fake images, thus lacking robustness and generalization ability. In this work, we innovatively investigate AI-generated image detection using bit-planes, and introduce the bit-reversed image. We propose a simple yet effective pipeline consisting of construction of bit-reversed images, gradient-based patch selection and a convolutional classifier. Besides, we provide a theoretical analysis from the mathematical perspective to demonstrate the validity of our approach. We also introduce two challenging datasets for AI-generated image detection. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness of our approach across different settings, including cross-generator generalization, cross-dataset generalization and zero-shot performance. Without bells and whistles, our approach outperforms existing methods on over 40 benchmarks, and is nearly 100 times faster than counterparts. The code is at https://github.com/renxi-seu/RAID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于位平面（bit-plane）的AI生成图像检测方法，通过构建位反转图像、基于梯度的补丁选择和卷积分类器组成的简单有效流水线，在40多个基准上超越现有方法，且速度比同类方法快近100倍。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法忽视了真实图像与伪造图像之间的内在差异，导致鲁棒性和泛化能力不足。随着图像生成模型的快速发展，亟需一种能够有效区分真实与AI生成图像的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出了一个由三部分组成的检测流水线：(1)构建位反转图像（bit-reversed image），利用真实与伪造图像在位平面上的内在差异；(2)基于梯度的补丁选择策略；(3)卷积神经网络分类器。此外还提供了数学角度的理论分析来验证方法的有效性，并引入了两个具有挑战性的数据集。
AI.result: 在超过40个基准测试上优于现有方法，涵盖跨生成器泛化、跨数据集泛化和零样本性能等不同设置，同时推理速度比同类别方法快近100倍。
AI.conclusion: 位平面分析为AI生成图像检测提供了一种新颖且有效的视角，该方法在保持高检测性能的同时大幅提升了效率，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Best Friends, Not Forever: Evaluating Long-Horizon Persona Collapse and Behavioral Drift in AI Companions
summary: As AI companions increasingly mediate repeated social interaction, users may rely on a stable role and shared history, yet locally acceptable replies do not ensure that either persists. We study two observable long-horizon failures: 'persona collapse', the loss of a deployed role, boundaries, values, or style, and 'behavioral drift', the gradual or recurrent erosion of those properties. We introduce ANCHOR, a controlled synthetic audit that separately measures persona enactment and trajectory recall. The study contains 2,008 conversations spanning 27 personas, nine interaction schedules, three generated memory settings, and four evaluated models. The Identity Probe combines a sealed 102-item questionnaire with turn-level judgments, while the Trajectory Probe scores 110 calibrated counterfactual questions from 35 conversation banks. Our results show that no evaluated model and configuration reliably preserves either dimensions: trajectory accuracy averages only 44.4%, user-state recall remains near four-option chance, and no tested context condition or memory consistently resolves these failures. Questionnaire retention also varies by model and persona facet, disagrees with turn-level behavior, and is sensitive to evaluator choice. These results indicate that current systems do not yet reliably support long-horizon companion continuity and that audits must distinguish persona enactment, trajectory recall, evaluator provenance, and deployment context rather than collapse them into a single trust or stability score.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI伴侣在长期交互中出现的两类失败模式——"人格塌缩"（persona collapse，角色设定丢失）和"行为漂移"（behavioral drift，行为特征逐渐或反复侵蚀），并提出了ANCHOR受控合成审计框架来分别测量人格呈现与轨迹回忆能力。实验包含2,008段对话、27个人格、9种交互日程、3种记忆设置和4个模型，结果表明所有模型和配置均无法可靠保持长期连续性。
AI.motivation: AI伴侣需要维持稳定的角色和共享历史，但局部可接受的回复并不能保证长期一致性。现有研究缺少对"人格塌缩"和"行为漂移"这两类长期失败模式的系统化测量方法。
AI.method: 提出了ANCHOR审计框架：1) 身份探针（Identity Probe）：密封的102项问卷加上逐轮判断；2) 轨迹探针（Trajectory Probe）：来自35个对话库的110个校准反事实问题。实验覆盖2,008段对话，27个人格，9种交互日程，3种生成记忆设置，4个评估模型。
AI.result: 轨迹准确率平均仅44.4%，用户状态回忆接近四选一随机水平，无任何上下文条件或记忆设置能可靠解决失败。问卷留存率因模型和人格方面而异，与逐轮行为不一致，且受评估者选择影响。
AI.conclusion: 当前系统无法可靠支持AI伴侣的长期连续性。审计必须区分人格呈现、轨迹回忆、评估者来源和部署环境，而不应将其合并为单一的信任或稳定性分数。

title: FairFund-Bench: Evaluating Distributive Bias in LLM Resource Allocation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in the distribution of scarce resources, raising concerns about biased allocations based on characteristics like race and gender. Recent LLM audits have produced inconsistent results, however, finding evidence of both positive and negative discrimination towards women and ethnic minorities, even for the same models. We show that this disagreement can arise from differences in audit format and introduce FairFund-Bench, a benchmark that systematically varies key features of previous audit designs: the evaluation task (rating, ranking, or allocation), comparison context (single or multi-stimulus), and whether the audit is transparent or disguised. The benchmark comprises 600 requests for financial assistance created from human-authored templates (calibrated against 1.3M real GoFundMe campaigns) across three domains, four race and two gender categories, and five causal framings of need derived from welfare deservingness theory. Across 14 models, audit format changes the direction of bias: models advantage minorities when rating claimants individually but penalize some groups when ranking them side by side. Bias magnitude, though small overall, is several times greater in disguised audits than in transparent ones, where, faced with appeals differing only in claimants' names, models overwhelmingly split funds equally. Causal framing effects, by contrast, exceed demographic effects by roughly an order of magnitude and are consistent across models and audit formats, indicating that current LLMs robustly reproduce human deservingness evaluations. The benchmark scores models on four criteria (demographic bias, deservingness alignment, cross-task consistency, and cross-context consistency), is publicly available, and can be readily adapted to other substantive domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，大型语言模型（LLM）在分配稀缺资源时存在偏见问题，但以往审计结果不一致。作者提出FairFund-Bench基准，系统变化审计格式（任务类型、比较语境、是否透明），发现审计格式会改变偏见方向，伪装审计比透明审计偏见更强，而因果框架效应远超人口统计学效应。基准包含600个财务援助请求，基于1.3M真实GoFundMe活动校准。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地参与稀缺资源分配，但现有审计研究结果不一致（同一模型既被发现有正面也有负面歧视），作者认为这种分歧源于审计设计差异，因此需要系统性研究审计格式对偏见检测结果的影响。
AI.method: 构建FairFund-Bench基准，系统变化三个审计设计特征：评估任务（评分、排名、分配）、比较语境（单刺激或多刺激）、审计透明度（透明或伪装）。基准包含由人类编写模板生成的600个财务援助请求，基于1.3M真实GoFundMe活动校准，涵盖三个领域、四个种族、两个性别类别及五种基于福利应得性理论的因果归因框架。在14个模型上进行测试。
AI.result: 审计格式会改变偏见方向：模型在单独评分时有利于少数群体，但在并排排名时会惩罚某些群体。伪装审计中的偏见幅度比透明审计大数倍（透明审计中模型倾向平分资金）。因果框架效应比人口统计学效应大约一个数量级，且跨模型和审计格式一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM虽然人口统计学偏见总体较小且受审计格式影响，但因果归因框架的影响稳健且显著，说明LLM可靠地再现了人类的福利应得性评价。基准从四个方面评估模型（人口偏见、应得性对齐、跨任务一致性、跨语境一致性），可推广到其他领域。

title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
summary: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个对齐问题的数学模型，其中智能体在部署前经历理想化的对齐训练，保证其价值函数满足代理条件，但研究发现即使经过训练，过度优化仍可能导致灾难性后果，因此建议限制优化压力（如使用分位数优化器）而非仅依赖部署前训练。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统承担更多责任，确保其与人类价值观对齐变得至关重要。AI安全领域普遍担心人类价值是脆弱的——过度优化不完美的代理价值函数可能导致灾难性结果。本文旨在从理论层面正式化这一问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个对齐问题的数学模型：智能体经历理想化的对齐训练，保证其价值函数满足代理条件后再进行世界优化。通过定义η-灾难性价值函数（保证在优化力极限下将人类价值期望降至η以下），分析人类价值函数和不同代理条件准确性的条件下，此类智能体何时会被部署。
AI.result: 论文识别出了人类价值函数以及多种代理条件精度的条件下，具有η-灾难性价值函数的智能体会被部署的充分/必要条件，证明了过度优化的危险性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果警示了过度优化的危险，并表明仅依赖部署前训练不足以保证AI安全，建议采用限制优化压力的AI设计（如分位数优化器）作为补充措施。

title: BLADE: Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models often improve task performance by generating long reasoning traces, but the resulting computation is frequently wasted on redundant verification and revision. Existing probe-based early-exit approaches mainly inspect explicit self-doubt expressions, leaving many earlier termination opportunities undetected. Expanding inspection to ordinary reasoning boundaries improves coverage, but also exposes highly diverse intermediate states whose predictive information may reside in different hidden layers. We present Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning (BLADE), a lightweight framework that dynamically terminates reasoning by estimating whether the generated prefix is sufficient for correct answering. BLADE constructs multi-granular checkpoints from sentence, self-doubt, and paragraph boundaries, and derives robust training labels through repeated answer completions. It further learns a compact subset of informative probe layers instead of relying on fixed choices or expensive representations from all layers. At inference time, calibrated predictions are combined with checkpoint-specific confirmation rules to balance responsiveness and premature-exit risk. Experiments on five benchmarks and two Qwen3 reasoning models show that BLADE preserves near-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 24.8% on Qwen3-8B and 15.8% on Qwen3-4B. Ablation studies further confirm the benefits of diverse checkpoints and automatic layer selection, demonstrating an effective approach to more efficient LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: BLADE是一个轻量级框架，通过多粒度检查点（句子、自我怀疑、段落边界）和自适应层选择，动态终止大语言模型的推理过程，在不损失准确率的情况下显著减少生成token数量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通过生成长推理链提升任务性能，但计算常常浪费在冗余验证和修正上。现有基于探针的早期退出方法主要检查显式自我怀疑表达，漏掉许多更早的终止机会；而扩展到普通推理边界虽能扩大覆盖，但中间状态高度多样，预测信息分散在不同隐藏层中。
AI.method: BLADE通过三个关键设计实现高效推理：(1) 从句子、自我怀疑和段落边界构建多粒度检查点，并通过重复回答补全推导鲁棒的训练标签；(2) 学习一个紧凑的探针层子集，避免固定层选择或全层高代价表示；(3) 推理时将校准预测与检查点特定的确认规则结合，平衡响应速度与过早退出风险。
AI.result: 在五个基准和两个Qwen3推理模型上，BLADE在保持接近基线准确率的同时，在Qwen3-8B上减少了24.8%的生成token，在Qwen3-4B上减少了15.8%。消融实验确认了多样化检查点和自动层选择的收益。
AI.conclusion: BLADE验证了通过多样化检查点和自适应层选择实现高效LLM推理的有效性，为动态早期退出推理提供了新思路，在计算效率与推理质量之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Adjudicated Captioning: Multi-Agent Alignment Scoring and Consensus-Distilled Beam Arbitration for Strict Zero-Shot Image Captioning
summary:
Zero-shot image captioning (ZIC) describes images without paired image-caption supervision during captioner training, relying on text-only corpora and frozen pretrained image-text scorers. Existing retrieval-augmented methods score image-text alignment once, at retrieval, then commit the captioner's autoregressive beam under language-model probability alone, leaving the decoder without further visual grounding feedback. Progress has stalled, with no method improving on the strict-regime best since 2024.
  We propose Adjudicated Captioning, an inference-time multi-agent framework that restores grounding feedback at multiple checkpoints over an unchanged IFCap captioner. First, we install a stronger frozen Retrieval Encoder at the input. Second, between retrieval and decoding we insert a frozen Cross-Attention Verifier that re-ranks the top-9 retrievals to top-5. Third, at the output beam we attach a learned Reranker pairing TriFuse, a multilayer perceptron, with MemAttend, a memory-attended transformer, the pipeline's only learned components; both are trained self-supervised by Borda-consensus distillation across the three frozen scorers, using no paired image-caption labels and no reference captions.
  Under the inductive headline protocol, with rerankers fit on the disjoint COCO Karpathy validation beam and applied frozen to test, the framework reaches CIDEr 117.6 and SPICE 21.9 on COCO Karpathy, up from 108.0 and 20.3 for IFCap, a +9.6 CIDEr gain, and +7.7 above NES, the strongest synthetic-image-augmented method at 109.9, without retraining the captioner. A training-free fixed-fusion baseline reaches 115.8 CIDEr, so +7.8 of the +9.6 gain comes from the non-learned architectural intervention and the remaining +1.8 from the learned rerankers. The same recipe transfers off-COCO without captioner retraining: +8.1 CIDEr on Flickr30k Karpathy and +5.7 on NoCaps overall.

AI.tldr: 提出Adjudicated Captioning，一个推理时的多智能体框架，通过在检索、解码和输出光束三个检查点恢复视觉接地反馈，在不重训练IFCap标题生成器的情况下，将COCO Karpathy CIDEr从108.0提升至117.6。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本图像描述（ZIC）的检索增强方法只在检索时进行一次图文对齐评分，解码过程中缺乏视觉接地反馈，导致自回归波束搜索仅受语言模型概率驱动，性能自2024年以来停滞不前。
AI.method: 提出Adjudicated Captioning推理时多智能体框架：(1) 在输入端安装更强的冻结检索编码器；(2) 在检索与解码之间插入冻结的交叉注意力验证器，将top-9重排为top-5；(3) 在输出波束处附加学习型重排器，由TriFuse（MLP）和MemAttend（记忆注意力Transformer）组成，通过Borda共识蒸馏在三个冻结评分器上自监督训练，无需配对图文标签或参考描述。
AI.result: 在COCO Karpathy上达到CIDEr 117.6和SPICE 21.9，较IFCap提升+9.6 CIDEr，比最强的合成图像增强方法NES高+7.7；其中+7.8来自非学习的架构干预，+1.8来自学习型重排器。跨数据集迁移表现：Flickr30k提升+8.1 CIDEr，NoCaps提升+5.7。
AI.conclusion: 通过多检查点注入视觉接地反馈而非仅靠一次检索评分，可以在不重训练标题生成器的情况下显著提升零样本图像描述性能，且架构性干预贡献了大部分增益，学习型重排器的增量在跨数据集上也能泛化。

title: Identifying Informative Environments for Cognition Parameter Inference via Bayesian Experimental Design
summary: Computational cognitive modeling seeks to infer latent cognitive mechanisms underlying observed behavior. Bayesian inverse planning provides a principled framework for such inference, but its success depends critically on the experimental environment. Existing approaches typically treat environments as fixed, leaving open the question of which cognitive experiments are most informative for cognition parameter inference. We formulate the design of cognitive planning experiments as a Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) problem, treating the experimental environment as the design variable. We establish an exact Monte Carlo BED benchmark and introduce an amortized Bayesian experimental design framework for efficient posterior inference and design evaluation. Experiments on the Mouselab-MDP process-tracing paradigm show that amortized BED closely matches the environment rankings of exact Monte Carlo BED while substantially reducing computational cost. We further show that no single environment is uniformly optimal across cognitive inference objectives, revealing trade-offs between expected information gain, posterior recoverability, and information efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for designing informative cognitive experiments for Bayesian parameter inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将认知规划实验设计形式化为贝叶斯实验设计（BED）问题，将实验环境视为设计变量，并引入摊销贝叶斯实验设计框架，在Mouselab-MDP范式上验证了其与精确蒙特卡洛BED相近的环境排序结果，同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的贝叶斯逆规划方法通常将实验环境视为固定不变的，这遗留了一个关键问题：哪些认知实验环境对于认知参数推断最具信息量？需要一种系统化的方法来设计最优的实验环境。
AI.method: 将认知规划实验设计形式化为BED问题，以实验环境作为设计变量；建立了精确蒙特卡洛BED基准；引入摊销贝叶斯实验设计框架用于高效的后验推断和设计评估；在Mouselab-MDP过程追踪范式上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 摊销BED与精确蒙特卡洛BED在环境排序上高度一致，但计算成本大幅降低；研究发现不存在单一环境对所有认知推断目标都均匀最优，揭示了期望信息增益、后验可恢复性和信息效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计信息量丰富的认知实验用于贝叶斯参数推断提供了原则性框架，并揭示了不同认知推断目标之间存在环境选择的权衡。

title: Mixture-of-Translators: Translating KV Caches Across Heterogeneous Large Language Models
summary: Heterogeneous Large Language Model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on shared contexts, retrieved evidence, and multi-agent dialogue histories, yet their internal key-value (KV) caches remain model-specific and cannot be reused across architectures. Consequently, each model must repeatedly prefill or store caches for the same context, limiting the scalability of multi-model reasoning and long-context generation. We propose Mixture-of-Translators(MoT), a cache translation framework that maps context KV caches from a source LLM into the cache space of a target LLM. Unlike prior approaches that depend on a single projection path or global shared latent space, MoT uses multiple translator modules to capture diverse source--target mappings. To further reduce residual translation error, we introduce a Context Correction Loss that aligns the replayed target trajectory with the native target trajectory. We reveal two competing failure modes in cache translation: propagated translation shift from early injection and last-state shift from late injection. MoT addresses them through translator mixtures and target-side correction. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous translations among Qwen2.5, GPT-2, and OPT models, MoT preserves downstream QA performance, including Qwen2.5-7B-scale translation with 51.0% average closed-set QA accuracy and 0.43 average extractive QA F1. In practical case studies, MoT enables quality-preserving memory reuse for multi-agent reasoning and retains 96.3% of direct-context quality in long-context cache-augmented generation, demonstrating scalable KV cache reuse across heterogeneous LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mixture-of-Translators（MoT）框架，通过多个翻译模块将源LLM的KV缓存映射到目标LLM的缓存空间，实现跨异构大模型的KV缓存复用，避免重复预填充，提升多模型推理和长上下文生成的扩展性。
AI.motivation: 异构LLM系统依赖共享上下文，但KV缓存是模型特定的，无法跨架构复用，导致每个模型需要重复预填充或存储相同上下文的缓存，限制了多模型推理和长上下文生成的扩展性。
AI.method: MoT框架使用多个翻译器模块捕获多样的源-目标映射关系，并提出Context Correction Loss来对齐重放的目标轨迹与原生目标轨迹。同时，针对缓存翻译中出现的两种竞争性失败模式（早期注入导致的传播平移和晚期注入导致的末态平移），通过翻译器混合和目标端修正来解决。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5、GPT-2和OPT模型之间的同构和异构翻译中，MoT保持了下游QA性能，包括Qwen2.5-7B规模翻译中51.0%的平均闭集QA准确率和0.43的平均抽取式QA F1分数。实际案例中，MoT实现了多智能体推理的质量保持性内存复用，在长上下文缓存增强生成中保留了直接上下文质量的96.3%。
AI.conclusion: MoT展示了跨异构LLM的可扩展KV缓存复用能力，通过翻译器混合和上下文修正有效解决了缓存翻译中的精度问题，为多模型系统提供了高效的内存复用方案。

title: CAER: Conflict-Aware Evidence Routing with Dual Prefix Experts for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding and generation. However, when textual inputs conflict with visual evidence, they still suffer from hallucinations and produce responses inconsistent with visual content. Existing approaches mainly rely on decoding strategies, additional training, verification methods, or prompting techniques, but often lack fine-grained conflict localization and conflict-aware generation. In this work, we propose CAER, a backbone-agnostic framework for visual-language conflict detection and conflict-aware generation. CAER introduces a span-grounded evidence router that transforms claim representations into soft textual queries and retrieves corresponding evidence from frozen visual tokens, enabling fine-grained conflict estimation. Furthermore, we design a dual-prefix expert routing mechanism that learns separate experts for visually supported and contradicted inputs, enabling conflict-aware generation through explicit expert selection. Experiments on the public MMMC benchmark and our newly curated AgriConflict dataset demonstrate that CAER effectively detects visual-language conflicts and improves the reliability of open-source MLLMs without updating their backbone parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAER框架，通过跨度级证据路由和双前缀专家路由机制，实现对视觉-语言冲突的细粒度检测与冲突感知生成，在不更新骨干参数的情况下提升MLLM的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在文本与视觉证据冲突时仍会产生幻觉，现有方法（解码策略、额外训练、验证方法、提示技术）缺乏细粒度的冲突定位和冲突感知生成能力。
AI.method: CAER包含两个核心组件：1) 跨度级证据路由器（span-grounded evidence router），将声明表示转化为软文本查询并从冻结的视觉token中检索对应证据，实现细粒度冲突估计；2) 双前缀专家路由机制（dual-prefix expert routing），为视觉支持和视觉矛盾的输入分别学习独立专家，通过显式专家选择实现冲突感知生成。该框架与骨干网络无关。
AI.result: 在公共MMMC基准测试和作者新构建的AgriConflict数据集上的实验表明，CAER能够有效检测视觉-语言冲突，并在不更新骨干参数的情况下提升开源MLLM的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: CAER通过细粒度冲突定位和冲突感知生成的结合，为缓解MLLM幻觉提供了一种无需修改骨干网络的有效方案。

title: NeSyFS: A Neuro-symbolic Fast-Slow Thinking Framework for LLM Agent under Partial Observability
summary: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in applications such as self-reflection, retrieval-augmented generation, and scientific discovery. In these settings, agents must act based on limited observations rather than full environmental states, leading to partial observability. This introduces several key challenges: belief state inference, task objective misalignment, and planning under uncertainty. Prior approaches typically condition actions on full or summarized action-observation histories whose redundant and irrelevant information can mislead the decision making of LLM agent. Inspired by human cognition, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic fast-slow thinking (NeSyFS) framework for LLM agent, addressing the challenges introduced by partial observability in a unified approach. We use a knowledge graph (KG) to represent the belief state, providing triplets as context for every module of NeSyFS. The fast-thinking module performs reactive action, while slow-thinking conducts a new uncertainty-aware planning by following the high-level structure of twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) algorithm. To mitigate the misalignment of task objective, a reflection module is used to reflect fast-thinking actions, and also switches to the slow-thinking module whenever reactive actions repeatedly fail. Experiments on three representative benchmarks, i.e. ALFWorld, Webshop, and ScienceWorld, demonstrate significant advantages over previous methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeSyFS框架，将知识图谱与神经符号快慢思考机制结合，通过TSMC算法进行不确定性感知规划，统一解决LLM智能体在部分可观测环境中的信念状态推断、任务目标错位和不确定性规划三大挑战，在ALFWorld、Webshop和ScienceWorld基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在部分可观测环境中面临信念状态推断、任务目标错位和不确定性规划三大关键挑战。现有方法依赖完整或摘要化的动作-观测历史，其中冗余和不相关信息会误导LLM的决策。
AI.method: 提出神经符号快慢思考（NeSyFS）框架：使用知识图谱表示信念状态，为各模块提供三元组上下文；快速思考模块执行反应性动作；慢速思考模块基于扭曲序贯蒙特卡洛（TSMC）算法进行不确定性感知规划；反思模块用于修正快速思考的动作，并在反应性动作反复失败时切换到慢速思考模块。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、Webshop和ScienceWorld三个代表性基准上的实验表明，该框架相比先前方法具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 受人类认知启发提出的NeSyFS框架通过统一方式有效解决了LLM智能体在部分可观测环境下的决策挑战，验证了神经符号结合快慢思考范式的有效性。

title: PARALLEL: A Prefrontal-Aligned Reinforcement inspired Approach for Language-Model Learning under Explicit Limits
summary: Recent language models achieve strong performance across a variety of tasks, but conventional adaptation applies updates uniformly across training samples regardless of their local update benefit. We propose PARALLEL, a prefrontal-aligned reinforcement inspired approach for language-model learning. Inspired by the complementary roles of goal-related and uncertainty-related control, PARALLEL represents these forms of information as separate controller signals and combines them with the current model representation. A reinforcement-inspired controller assigns sample-dependent update intensity using immediate utility-cost feedback. PARALLEL therefore learns when and how strongly to adapt to each sample, prioritizing beneficial updates while limiting unnecessary parameter changes. PARALLEL uses available updates more efficiently than selective baselines while retaining 94.1--99.2\% of Full-adaptation performance. Beyond multiple-choice reasoning, experiments on XSum and CNN/DailyMail show that PARALLEL retains 96.9--98.6\% of the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 scores achieved by Full adaptation and 98.8--98.9\% of the corresponding ROUGE-L scores. When compared at the same cumulative adaptation time or GPU energy, PARALLEL achieves higher ARC accuracy and exhibits a more stable late-stage adaptation trajectory than Full adaptation in the representative run. These results show that learning when and how strongly to update each sample supports stable and efficient post-deployment stream adaptation while avoiding unnecessary updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PARALLEL方法，一种受前额叶皮层对齐和强化学习启发的语言模型适应方法。它通过分离"目标相关"和"不确定性相关"两种控制信号，并利用强化启发式控制器为每个训练样本分配自适应的更新强度，从而学习何时以及以多大力度更新模型，在保持全量适应性能94.1%-99.2%的同时，显著提升了更新效率和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型适应方法对所有训练样本统一应用更新，未考虑每个样本的局部更新收益差异，导致不必要的参数更新和较低的训练效率。
AI.method: PARALLEL借鉴前额叶皮层中目标相关和不确定性相关控制的互补角色，将这两种信息表示为独立的控制器信号并与当前模型表征结合。一个受强化学习启发的控制器利用即时效用-成本反馈为每个样本分配依赖样本的更新强度，实现选择性、动态化的参数更新。
AI.result: 在多项选择推理任务中保留全量适应性能的94.1%-99.2%；在XSum和CNN/DailyMail摘要任务中保留ROUGE-1和ROUGE-2分数的96.9%-98.6%及ROUGE-L的98.8%-98.9%。在相同累计适应时间或GPU能耗下，PARALLEL比全量适应获得更高的ARC准确率，并表现出更稳定的后期适应轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 学习何时以及以何种强度更新每个样本，能够支持稳定且高效的部署后流式适应，同时避免不必要的参数更新，相比选择性基线和全量适应方法都具有明显优势。

title: From Inline Notes to Collected Commentaries: Toward Context-Preserving Organization of Exegetical Knowledge in Classical Chinese Texts
summary: Inline notes and collected commentaries are important forms of scholarly communication that evolved within the Confucian exegetical tradition, yet have received little computational attention. Drawing on traditional Chinese exegetics and philology, this paper formulates collected commentary compilation as an NLP task and proposes a computational framework that preserves the contextual dependency of inline notes while enabling their automatic compilation and exegetical knowledge organization. It combines two-step prompt chaining for identifying the associated main-text segments and exegetical functions of annotations with cross-source mention clustering for integrating commentary across editions, achieving a CoNLL F1 score above 97% in a case study on the Classic of Mountains. Our framework lays the foundation for the large-scale organization of historical exegetical knowledge, thereby supporting a broad range of downstream philological and NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将中国传统经学中的"集注汇编"任务形式化为NLP任务，提出一个结合两阶段提示链与跨来源指称聚类的计算框架，在《山海经》案例研究中实现了超过97%的CoNLL F1分数，为历史经学知识的大规模组织奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 批注与集注是中国经学传统中重要的学术交流形式，但长期以来缺乏计算层面的关注。传统经学注疏的整理依赖人工，效率低下且难以规模化，亟需计算化的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一个计算框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 两阶段提示链（two-step prompt chaining），用于识别批注对应的主文段落及其经学功能；(2) 跨来源指称聚类（cross-source mention clustering），用于整合不同版本中的注释。框架基于传统中国经学与文献学理论设计，保持批注的上下文依赖性。
AI.result: 以《山海经》为案例研究，该框架在CoNLL F1评分上达到了97%以上，验证了方法的有效性与可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为历史经学知识的大规模组织奠定了坚实基础，能够支持广泛的文献学及NLP下游任务，填补了传统经学注疏计算化研究的空白。

title: Evaluation-Verification Reward for Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing
summary: While recent image editing models have made rapid progress, multi-reference editing remains challenging, particularly in maintaining visual consistency across references and ensuring overall visual harmony. Reinforcement learning has proven highly effective for text-to-image generation and single-image editing, but its extension to multi-reference editing is hindered by the absence of suitable reward models that capture multi-image relational constraints. Moreover, naively using multimodal large language models(MLLMs) as zero-shot evaluators faces a key tension between hallucination-prone long-form reasoning and the limited deductive power of short-form judgments. We address these issues with a Multi-dimensional Evaluation-Verification Reward(EVR). EVR decomposes evaluation into distinct visual criteria; for each criterion, an MLLM Evaluator generates multiple candidate hypotheses, and a Verifier grounds each claim in concrete visual evidence to accept or reject it, producing reliable and fine-grained reward signals. Together with a scalable data pipeline, our method enables RL fine-tuning of off-the-shelf editors without architectural changes. Extensive experiments show substantial gains over the base Qwen-Image-Edit, improving consistency and harmony to match or surpass NanoBanana.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多维评估-验证奖励（EVR）机制，通过分解视觉评价标准、生成多个候选假设并由验证器基于视觉证据进行判定，解决了多参考图像编辑中强化学习缺乏可靠奖励模型的问题，在不改变模型架构的情况下显著提升了编辑一致性与和谐性。
AI.motivation: 多参考图像编辑在保持视觉一致性和整体和谐性方面仍具挑战性。强化学习虽在文本生成图像和单图编辑中表现优异，但扩展到多参考编辑时缺乏能够捕捉多图像关系约束的奖励模型。此外，直接使用多模态大语言模型作为零样本评估器面临"长形式推理易产生幻觉、短形式判断推理能力不足"的两难困境。
AI.method: 提出多维评估-验证奖励（EVR）：将评估分解为多个独立的视觉评价标准；对每个标准，多模态大语言模型评估器生成多个候选假设；验证器将每个假设与具体视觉证据关联以接受或拒绝，从而产生可靠且细粒度的奖励信号。配合可扩展的数据流水线，实现对现成编辑器的强化学习微调，无需修改架构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法相较于基础模型Qwen-Image-Edit有显著提升，在一致性和和谐性上达到或超越了NanoBanana的水平。
AI.conclusion: EVR通过"评估-验证"的分解机制有效解决了多参考编辑中奖励模型缺失和MLLM评估不可靠的问题，为多参考图像编辑的强化学习微调提供了可行路径。

title: Scaling Scientific Discovery Environments for Turn-Level Agentic RL
summary: Large language model agents have shown promising capabilities in data-driven scientific discovery tasks, where an agent interacts with an execution environment and produces a statistical claim. Long-horizon scientific analysis remains constrained by the lack of process supervised environments over real-world scientific data. This paper introduces SciDisco, a scalable framework for training Scientific Discovery agents in process-verifiable environments. SciThèque compiles hypotheses, datasets, hidden evidence graphs, and verifiers into task environments where analytical progress can be checked during interaction. DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis uses these environments to construct verifier-filtered multi-turn demonstrations. DiscoPO then uses the environment as the source of training signal, assigning turn-level credit to actions that produce verifiable analytical evidence. Experiments show that SciDisco-14B reaches state-of-the-art on hypothesis-driven scientific data analysis benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciDisco框架，通过构建过程可验证的科学发现环境，训练大语言模型智能体在长周期科学数据分析任务中达到最先进水平。框架包含SciThèque环境编译器、DAG-grounded轨迹合成和DiscoPO训练算法三个核心组件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在数据驱动的科学发现任务中展现出潜力，但长周期科学分析受限于缺少基于真实科学数据的过程监督环境，难以在交互过程中检查和分析智能体的每一步进展。
AI.method: 三个核心组件：(1) SciThèque将假设、数据集、隐藏证据图和验证器编译成任务环境，可在交互过程中检查分析进展；(2) DAG-grounded轨迹合成利用这些环境生成经过验证器过滤的多轮演示；(3) DiscoPO以环境为训练信号源，为产生可验证分析证据的动作分配回合级信用。
AI.result: SciDisco-14B在假设驱动的科学数据分析基准上达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建过程可验证的科学发现环境并提供可扩展的训练框架，能够有效提升LLM智能体在长周期科学分析任务中的表现，证明了过程级监督对于科学发现智能体训练的重要价值。

title: Tokenizer-Agnostic Engram Module
summary: Deepseek's Engram, a conditional memory module, was introduced to trade-off storage versus reasoning in large language models. However, the module relies on token-level $N$-gram hashing for Engram embedding lookup, introducing a tight coupling to the tokenizer used: a model with a different tokenizer would have to train its own Engram embeddings from scratch. To improve the reusability of Engram embeddings, we propose a change to the hashing routine, enabling compatibility between Engram models using different tokenizers. Instead of modelling disjoint $N$-gram spaces, we treat $N$-gram as a method to sample potentially useful byte sequences, from all possible byte sequences across tokens. We replace the XOR-based hashing with the general polynomial hashing with a joint embedding space across $N$. This work investigates the possible trade-offs and shows that this simple substitution produces comparable performance and achieves tokenizer-agnosticism: hash equivalence for byte-equivalent token sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进DeepSeek Engram条件记忆模块的哈希函数，将基于token的N-gram哈希替换为通用的多项式哈希，使Engram嵌入在多tokenizer之间可复用，实现tokenizer无关性。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek的Engram模块使用基于token级别的N-gram哈希进行嵌入查找，这导致嵌入与特定tokenizer紧密耦合——换用不同tokenizer的模型必须从头训练自己的Engram嵌入，限制了嵌入的重用性。
AI.method: 将N-gram从建模不相交的token空间改为从所有跨token的字节序列中采样潜在有用的字节序列；用通用多项式哈希替代XOR哈希，并在不同的N值间建立联合嵌入空间，使得字节等价的token序列产生相同的哈希。
AI.result: 这种简单的替换在保持可比性能的同时实现了tokenizer无关性：对于字节等价的token序列，哈希结果等价。
AI.conclusion: 通过将哈希从token级解耦到字节级，Engram嵌入可以在不同tokenizer之间复用，在不牺牲性能的前提下提升了记忆模块的通用性和可迁移性。

title: MMShopBench: A Real-Log Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Turn Shopping Agents
summary: Online shoppers increasingly turn to AI shopping assistants, using images and multi-turn dialogue to express and refine product needs that are difficult to articulate in text alone. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on text-only or synthetic requests, underrepresenting complex real-world shopping requirements jointly expressed through images and language. We introduce MMShopBench, the first real-log benchmark for multimodal, multi-turn shopping agents. Built from carefully cleaned and manually annotated shopping logs, MMShopBench provides ground-truth annotations of each request's purchase intent and mandatory product requirements. Agents must infer these requirements jointly from user images and multi-turn dialogue, retrieve candidate products through image and text search, and verify that each candidate satisfies all requirements using its product images and structured attributes. We evaluate representative open-source and proprietary models using an evidence-grounded multimodal protocol and construct a companion training set for fine-tuning an open-source model. To ensure reproducible experimentation, we build an offline shopping sandbox, where fine-tuning substantially narrows the performance gap between our open-source model and leading proprietary models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMShopBench，这是首个基于真实购物日志的多模态、多轮对话购物智能体基准测试，包含购买意图和强制性产品需求的细粒度人工标注，并配套离线购物沙盘与训练数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有购物智能体基准大多依赖纯文本或合成请求，无法充分代表现实世界中通过图像与语言混合表达的复杂购物需求，导致对多模态、多轮购物智能体的能力评估不够准确。
AI.method: 从经过精心清洗和人工标注的购物日志构建MMShopBench基准，提供每项请求的购买意图和强制性产品需求的真实标注；智能体需从用户图像和多轮对话中联合推断需求，通过图文搜索检索候选产品，并基于产品图像和结构化属性验证候选是否满足所有要求。同时构建配套训练集用于微调开源模型，并搭建离线购物沙盘以确保可复现的实验环境。
AI.result: 评估了多个代表性开源和专有模型，发现微调显著缩小了开源模型与领先专有模型之间的性能差距，验证了训练数据的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MMShopBench填补了多模态多轮购物智能体真实场景评测的空白，其训练集和离线沙盘为开源模型追赶专有模型提供了有效途径。

title: Semantics of Subterfuge: Benchmarking Legal Deception Detection Against General-domain State-of-the-Art
summary: Deception detection has critical implications for legal proceedings, law enforcement, and online security. Although human judgment is limited in accuracy and scalability, Natural Language Processing (NLP) offers a data-driven alternative. We present a survey and comparative analysis of NLP-based Automatic Deception Detection (ADD) focusing on the legal domain, reviewing the evolution from feature-based machine learning to Large Language Model (LLM) approaches. We conduct a unified empirical evaluation across seven datasets (two legal, five general-domain), comparing six fine-tuned transformer models and seven LLMs under four prompting strategies. The results show strong domain sensitivity, with fine-tuned models excelling in data-rich general domains and few-shot LLMs remaining competitive in low-resource legal settings. Chain-of-Thought prompting often underperforms direct classification. These findings highlight the need for domain adaptation and interpretable systems in high-stakes legal contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于NLP的自动欺骗检测（ADD）进行了综述和比较分析，聚焦法律领域。作者在七个数据集（两个法律、五个通用领域）上进行了统一的实证评估，比较了六个微调Transformer模型和七个大语言模型（LLM）在四种提示策略下的表现。研究发现显著的领域敏感性：微调模型在数据丰富的通用领域表现优异，而少样本LLM在低资源法律场景中保持竞争力；思维链提示往往不如直接分类。
AI.motivation: 欺骗检测在法律诉讼、执法和网络安全中具有关键意义，但人类判断在准确性和可扩展性上受限，因此需要NLP提供数据驱动的替代方案。作者旨在系统梳理该领域从传统特征工程到LLM方法的演进，并在统一框架下进行公平的跨模型比较。
AI.method: 作者开展了范围综述并结合统一实证评估。具体包括：在七个数据集（两个法律域、五个通用域）上，对六个微调Transformer模型和七个LLM进行对比实验，采用四种不同的提示策略（包括直接分类和思维链等）进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示了强领域敏感性：微调模型在数据充足的通用领域表现更优，而少样本LLM在低资源法律场景中具有竞争力；思维链提示在多数情况下表现不如直接分类，提示该策略在此任务中并非总是有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了在高风险法律场景中，欺骗检测系统需要领域适应性和可解释性。不同模型类型在不同数据条件下的优势互补，提示未来应关注面向法律领域的定制化模型设计和可解释的检测系统。

title: GO-PRE: Goal-Oriented Next-Best-View Selection via Predictive Rendering Entropy for Active 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Active 3D reconstruction relies on active view selection to maximize reconstruction fidelity under limited capture budgets. However, most existing methods rely on surrogate signals such as parameter uncertainty or geometric heuristics, but these signals are often misaligned with the ultimate goal: the fidelity of rendered predictions. We propose GO-PRE, a goal-oriented next-best-view selection framework that explicitly targets information gain in the prediction space. Specifically, we formulate the objective as maximizing the reduction of the average marginal predictive entropy over a user-specified target view manifold. GO-PRE supports interactive goal specification and yields an efficient acquisition rule that enables real-time computation of information gain. Extensive experiments across benchmarks demonstrate that GO-PRE consistently improves active reconstruction performance and provides more reliable uncertainty quantification compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: GO-PRE是一种目标导向的主动3D重建视角选择框架，通过最大化用户指定目标视角流形上的边际预测熵减少来实现信息增益最大化，支持交互式目标指定并支持实时计算。
AI.motivation: 现有主动3D重建方法依赖参数不确定性或几何启发式等替代信号，但这些信号与最终目标（渲染预测的保真度）常常不对齐，导致视角选择效果不佳。
AI.method: 将目标形式化为最大化用户指定目标视角流形上平均边际预测熵的减少量；提出高效采集规则，支持实时信息增益计算和交互式目标指定。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GO-PRE相比最先进方法持续提升主动重建性能，并提供更可靠的不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: GO-PRE通过直接在预测空间中优化信息增益而非依赖替代信号，有效提升了主动3D重建的视角选择质量，同时保持了实时计算效率。

title: Evidence-Grounded Constraint Checking in Construction Documents
summary: Professional-document review is a constraint-checking problem in which decisions depend on relations among text, geometry, pages, and document revisions. We present an evidence-grounded pipeline that normalizes extracted facts, executes four-state rules deterministically, retains source spans, and escalates unresolved cases. We evaluate its PDF evidence allocator on 160 reference-based tasks from 29 construction projects using a repeated four-system test and a disjoint two-system breadth extension. In the repeated test, reallocating a four-image budget from retrieved page overviews to one overview and three overlapping tiles improves project-family standardized decision accuracy by 10.6 percentage points (95% project-cluster bootstrap CI: 4.3 to 18.0; exact p = 0.031). This effect does not persist in the broader block: Region-RAG changes accuracy by -4.1 points (95% CI: -10.2 to 1.9; exact p = 0.209), while an equal-image sensitivity favors page breadth. Exact finding-set recovery remains low, false passes remain common, and repeated-run agreement is poorly calibrated. The results identify a resolution-breadth trade-off rather than a universal advantage for region-focused evidence, motivating rule-aware evidence routing and expert review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于证据的专业文档审阅管线，通过四态规则确定性执行和源文本跨度保留来处理约束检查任务，并评估了PDF证据分配器在160个任务上的表现，发现证据分辨率与覆盖广度之间存在权衡而非普适优势。
AI.motivation: 专业文档审阅本质上是约束检查问题，其决策依赖于文本、几何、页面和文档修订之间的关系。现有方法在证据分配上缺乏系统性评估，特别是区域聚焦证据（如图片瓦片）与页面广度证据之间的优劣尚无明确结论。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于证据的管线：规范化提取事实、确定性地执行四态规则、保留源文本跨度、并对未决案例进行升级处理。采用重复四系统测试（160个参考任务，来自29个建筑项目）和不重叠双系统广度扩展评估PDF证据分配器，对比四图片预算分配为页面概览与三重叠瓦片加一概览两种策略。
AI.result: 在重复测试中，将四图片预算从检索页面概览重新分配为一概览加三重叠瓦片，使项目族标准化决策准确率提高10.6个百分点（95% CI: 4.3-18.0；精确p=0.031）。但在更广泛的区块中该效果不持续：Region-RAG改变准确率-4.1点（95% CI: -10.2至1.9；p=0.209）。精确发现集恢复率仍然较低，错误通过仍然常见，重复运行一致性校准不佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了证据分辨率与广度之间存在权衡关系，而非区域聚焦证据具有普适优势，这促使需要基于规则的证据路由和专家审阅介入。

title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
summary: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations and an image-swap intervention instead identify stale visual and generated-text states as contributors to drift. For the tested Fast-dLLM implementation, shortening the KV-cache refresh interval yields a monotonic speed--agreement frontier and near-exact agreement at a measured 1.3x speedup. The initial diagnosis also appears with dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, although dLLM-Cache recovers agreement only after both caches are tightened, which removes its speed advantage. Independent prompts and images reproduce the threshold-insensitivity and refresh recovery. A targeted audit finds genuine content substitution in half of 50 low-agreement pairs. In a separate blinded two-annotator evaluation, the pooled accelerated-minus-baseline factual-error difference is 0.00 (95% CI [-0.17,+0.17]); this sample detects no difference but does not establish factual equivalence. Finally, none of the tested adaptive or smoothed-refresh variants beats the fixed interval at matched compute. Our contribution is a paired diagnostic and an implementation-scoped consistency control, not an accuracy or safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于扩散的多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）在无训练加速下的服务一致性（serving-time consistency）问题。通过在300张真实图像上对比Fast-dLLM加速输出与未加速基线输出，发现置信度阈值调优无法改变一致性，但KV缓存刷新间隔缩短可带来单调的速度-一致性前沿，在1.3倍加速下达到近乎完全一致。同时发现内容漂移主要由过期的视觉和生成文本状态导致。文章还验证了该诊断在其他dMLLMs方法中的普适性，并指出这只是一个诊断工具和实现范围的一致性控制，而非准确性或安全性的保证。
AI.motivation: 无训练加速方法使dMLLMs更易于部署，但加速可能静默改变生成内容，这种服务期一致性问题尚未被系统研究。作者希望通过成对诊断实验，识别加速导致内容漂移的根源，并为实际部署提供一致性控制手段。
AI.method: 在300张真实图像上进行成对比较实验，将Fast-dLLM加速输出与同模型未加速输出对比。采用长文本设置（每步1.05-1.25个已提交token），进行置信度阈值调优实验、状态刷新消融实验和图像交换干预实验来定位漂移来源。此外还在dLLM-Cache和LaViDa上进行诊断验证，并结合人工盲评（双标注者）评估事实错误差异。
AI.result: 置信度阈值调优只改变解码行为但不改变基线一致性；状态刷新消融和图像交换实验表明过期的视觉和生成文本状态是漂移的主要来源。缩短KV缓存刷新间隔产生单调的速度-一致性前沿，在1.3倍加速下达成近乎完全一致。dLLM-Cache需要同时收紧两个缓存才能恢复一致性但失去速度优势。50个低一致性对中有一半存在真实内容替换，双标注者盲评的事实错误差异为0.00（95% CI [-0.17, +0.17]），所有自适应或平滑刷新变体在相同计算量下均未优于固定间隔。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种配对的诊断方法和实现范围的一致性控制手段，揭示了dMLLM加速中内容漂移的根源在于陈旧状态，并给出了可操作的一致性恢复策略。但作者明确声明该工作不提供准确性或安全性保证，且当前样本无法建立事实等价性。

title: On the Generalization of Steering Vectors for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Model capabilities have improved in large part due to scaling chain of thought. This has been a promising development for AI safety--where models verbalize their reasoning, it is possible to monitor it. However, in some cases, models do not verbalize important steps in their reasoning process. For example, models prompted with a cue suggesting the incorrect answer may fail to acknowledge that cue, even when it appears instrumental to their conclusion. When chain of thought (CoT) fails to disclose instrumental reasoning steps, we describe it as unfaithful. Prior work has shown that activation steering can be a useful method to improve faithfulness in CoT. We extend this line of work by studying how well steering for faithfulness generalizes across cue types, datasets, and methods of constructing the steering vector for three models (Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, Gemma-3 12B) in a cued question-answering setting. While steering reliably increases cue acknowledgment for only the largest model (Gemma-3 12B), we find that when steering is effective, its effect generalizes broadly across cue types and datasets--in cross-cue and cross-dataset analyses, effect size is determined primarily by the evaluation setting, rather than the vector's train setting. How the vector is built also matters little--four construction methods, including one whose optimization target mentions no specific cue, yield similar effect sizes. Finally, we consider the possibility that steering promotes the salience of the cue and causes greater cue use, rather than targeting verbalization behaviors. However, we find no evidence for this--steering leaves the rate of cue use roughly unchanged while reducing hidden cue use, i.e., cue use that is not acknowledged.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了激活引导（activation steering）方法在提升思维链（CoT）忠实性方面的泛化能力，发现引导在最大模型上有效，且效果能跨线索类型和数据集泛化，向量构建方法影响不大，同时排除了引导主要通过提高线索显著性而非改变语言化行为的可能性。
AI.motivation: 思维链（CoT）是提升模型能力和AI安全的重要途径，但模型有时不会语言化推理中的关键步骤（即不忠实的CoT），例如面对暗示错误答案的线索时未能在推理中提及该线索。先验工作表明激活引导可以改善CoT的忠实性，但缺乏对其泛化能力的系统性研究。
AI.method: 在提示性问答（cued question-answering）设置下，针对三个模型（Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, Gemma-3 12B），系统地研究了激活引导在跨线索类型、跨数据集以及不同引导向量构建方法下的忠实性提升效果。同时检验了引导是否通过提升线索显著性（salience）而非直接改变语言化行为来起作用。
AI.result: 引导仅在最大模型（Gemma-3 12B）上可靠地提升了线索承认率；当引导有效时，其效果能广泛泛化到不同的线索类型和数据集，效果大小主要由评估设置而非向量训练设置决定；四种向量构建方法效果相近，包括一种优化目标不涉及具体线索的方法；引导并未改变线索使用率，而是减少了隐藏的（未被承认的）线索使用。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导提升CoT忠实性的效果具有较好的泛化性，但其可靠性依赖模型规模；引导的作用机制是减少隐藏的线索使用（即促进语言化），而非简单地提高线索显著性。

title: A Generalized-Bayes Perspective on Counterfactual Explanations: Posterior-Based Decision-Making and Evaluation
summary: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) enhance the interpretability of machine learning models by identifying the smallest change to an input required to obtain a desired output. Although CEs are conventionally formulated as a distance-minimization problem, the theoretical basis of this formulation has received limited attention. We show that a distance-minimization-based CE is mathematically equivalent to the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate of a Gibbs posterior within the generalized Bayes framework, specifically when a distance-based prior is used. We call this formulation the Distance-Prior Generalized Bayes CE (DP-GBCE). Building on this posterior perspective, we introduce two decision rules beyond MAP within a unified framework: a Bayes decision that minimizes expected decision loss and CVaR-CE, a risk-averse decision rule. We also propose an extension that uses Bayesian model weights to mix the posterior distributions of multiple models, thereby accounting for model multiplicity, where several models have comparable predictive performance. Finally, we define metrics for evaluating both individual CEs and the posterior distribution as a whole, and use experiments on simulated data and Google Trends data to quantify the trade-offs among the decision rules.

AI.tldr: 本文从广义贝叶斯框架出发，证明基于距离最小化的反事实解释（CE）等价于使用距离先验的Gibbs后验的最大后验（MAP）估计，并在此基础上提出统一的DP-GBCE框架，引入贝叶斯决策规则和CVaR-CE风险厌恶决策规则，同时通过贝叶斯模型权重混合多个模型的后验分布来处理模型多重性问题。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释是机器学习可解释性的重要工具，传统上被表述为距离最小化问题，但该表述的理论基础长期缺乏深入探讨，本文旨在填补这一理论空白并为CE提供更严谨的贝叶斯视角。
AI.method: 将距离最小化CE与Gibbs后验的MAP估计建立数学等价性，提出DP-GBCE框架；在该框架内引入两种超越MAP的决策规则（最小化期望决策损失的贝叶斯决策和风险厌恶的CVaR-CE）；利用贝叶斯模型加权混合多个模型的后验分布以考虑模型多重性；并定义评估指标。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和Google Trends数据上的实验量化了不同决策规则之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: DP-GBCE为反事实解释提供了统一的贝叶斯理论框架，支持多种决策规则并考虑模型多重性，拓展了CE方法的设计空间和应用范围。

title: M3-DuplexBench: A Multi-Turn, Multilingual, Multidomain Benchmark for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems (FDSDSs) can listen while speaking, enabling natural behaviors such as smooth turn-taking, backchannel handling, and user barge-in handling. However, fair comparisons in multi-turn conversations remain a challenge. In addition, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of languages and dialogue domains. We propose M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual, multidomain benchmark for FDSDSs. M3-DuplexBench supports English and Japanese and covers both casual conversation and multi-turn question answering. In addition, we evaluate models under multiple dialogue context settings, including single-turn, user-only, and teacher-forced full-context settings, to analyze how dialogue history affects model behavior. Experiments with recent FDSDSs reveal model-specific turn-taking characteristics, clear performance gaps across languages and domains, and mixed effects of dialogue context.

AI.tldr: 提出了M3-DuplexBench，一个用于全双工口语对话系统的多轮、多语言、多领域基准测试，支持英语和日语，涵盖闲聊和多轮问答，并在多种对话上下文设置下评估模型。
AI.motivation: 全双工口语对话系统虽然能实现自然交互行为，但现有基准在多轮对话公平比较上存在挑战，且语言和对话领域的覆盖有限。
AI.method: 构建M3-DuplexBench基准，支持英语和日语，覆盖闲聊会话和多轮问答两个领域；在单轮、仅用户、教师强制全上下文等多种对话上下文设置下评估模型，分析对话历史对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现不同模型具有特定的轮次转换特征，跨语言和跨领域存在明显的性能差距，对话上下文的影响呈现混合效应。
AI.conclusion: M3-DuplexBench为全双工口语对话系统提供了更全面、更公平的评估基准，揭示了模型在跨语言、跨领域和不同上下文条件下的行为差异。

title: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds through Complementarity-Driven Iterative Collaboration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings, yet individual models remain bounded by model-specific capability limitations. These heterogeneous boundaries pose a deployment challenge, but also create an opportunity: strategically coordinating multiple LLMs may unlock collective intelligence exceeding any single model. Existing approaches fix how models are combined in advance, overlooking the dynamic, state-dependent role of complementarity in complex problem solving. Drawing on the wisdom-of-crowds paradigm, we reconceptualize collective LLM intelligence as relay-style complementarity: a sequential process in which each successor model is selected to address the specific bottleneck identified in its predecessor's output. To operationalize this, we propose WILC (Wisdom Integration of LLM Crowds), a framework grounded in two design principles. First, iterative reflection-and-refinement establishes a state-preserving workflow through which models diagnose and refine prior outputs. Second, complementarity-driven model selection governs transitions via a dual-gate mechanism: prospective complementarity fit (PCF) identifies the worker most suited to the current bottleneck, while posterior complementarity gain (PCG) evaluates whether the selected transition improves the evolving solution. Experiments across four diverse benchmarks show that WILC outperforms existing approaches, including single-model self-refinement, ensemble methods, and query-routing methods. Under standardized pricing assumptions, WILC matches the average benchmark performance of GPT-5.2 at roughly 7 times lower estimated per-query cost, while facilitating data sovereignty through self-hosted deployment. This study extends wisdom-of-crowds theory from static aggregation to sequential AI complementarity and provides transferable design principles for multi-AI coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WILC框架，将大语言模型群体智能视为接力式互补协作，通过迭代反思-精炼和互补性驱动的模型选择（含PCF和PCG双门控机制）动态组合多个LLM，在四个基准上超越单模型自精炼、集成和查询路由等方法，并以约7倍更低的成本达到接近GPT-5.2的平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在复杂任务中各受能力边界限制，而现有方案固定预先设定模型组合方式，未能利用模型间动态的、状态依赖的互补性来释放超越单模型的群体智能。
AI.method: 提出WILC框架，包含两大设计原则：(1) 迭代反思-精炼的状态保留工作流，使后继模型诊断并改进前序输出；(2) 互补性驱动的模型选择，通过前瞻互补性适配度（PCF）挑选最适合当前瓶颈的工人模型，并通过后验互补性增益（PCG）评估所选转换是否改进演化中的解决方案。
AI.result: 在四个多样化基准上，WILC优于单模型自精炼、集成方法和查询路由方法；在标准化定价假设下，WILC以约7倍更低的每查询估计成本匹配GPT-5.2的平均基准性能，同时支持自托管部署以保障数据主权。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将智慧众包理论从静态聚合拓展到序列化AI互补性场景，并为多AI协调提供了可迁移的设计原则。

title: Authorship Verification of Transcribed German-Language Videos
comment: 6 pages, planning to submit to WIFS 2026
summary: Authorship Verification (AV) represents an important subfield of digital text forensics and addresses the fundamental question of whether two texts were written by the same author. Although the field has made substantial progress over the past two decades, several important challenges remain unresolved or underexplored. For instance, most AV research has focused on written texts, despite the fact that language is expressed not only in written but also in spoken form, such as in videos. Moreover, existing AV studies have predominantly concentrated on English, while other languages, including German, have received comparatively little attention. To address these research gaps, we apply AV to spoken language in the form of transcripts of German-language videos and examine the effectiveness of established AV methods in verifying a speaker's identity across video pairs. Our experimental evaluation, based on a total of ten AV methods applied to three self-compiled corpora comprising 300 videos from 150 speakers, shows that the best performance (up to 88% accuracy and 90% AUC) is achieved by traditional AV approaches based on simple character- and token n-gram representations. In contrast, more modern transformer-based approaches perform significantly worse on all evaluated corpora. Our results therefore suggest that traditional methods in the field of AV remain both competitive and relevant.

AI.tldr: 本研究将作者验证（AV）技术首次应用于德语视频转录文本中，通过十种AV方法对三个自建语料库（150位说话者的300个视频）进行评估，发现传统基于字符和词元n-gram的方法表现最佳（准确率高达88%，AUC达90%），而现代基于Transformer的方法表现显著较差。
AI.motivation: 现有作者验证研究主要集中于书面文本和英语，对德语等语言的语音形式（如视频中的口语）研究不足。为填补这一研究空白，作者将AV方法应用于德语视频转录文本以验证说话者身份。
AI.method: 研究者将AV技术应用于德语视频转录文本，构建了三个自编语料库（包含150位说话者的300个视频），并对十种不同的AV方法进行了系统评估，比较传统n-gram方法与现代基于Transformer方法的表现。
AI.result: 传统基于简单字符和词元n-gram表示的AV方法表现最佳，准确率高达88%，AUC达90%；而现代基于Transformer的方法在所有评估语料库上表现显著较差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，传统方法在作者验证领域仍然具有竞争力和相关性，挑战了现代深度学习方法在该领域必然占优的假设。

title: CAGE: Certified Authorization under Typed-Return Uncertainty for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents act on typed tool returns, records pairing provenance and categorical fields with numerical values. Runtime permission gates generally authorize the observed return and action, leaving the decision unprotected against small errors in how the return was bound to its source. We ask whether a candidate action stays authorized over a declared neighborhood of plausible correctly bound returns: one admissible binding fault plus bounded numerical drift. We prove that certifying the categorical and numerical channels separately does not compose: perturbations that are safe on each channel alone can jointly turn the same action unsafe. CAGE certifies this joint neighborhood directly, enumerating the discrete branches exactly and certifying the continuous perturbation within each branch. Across synthetic, policy-as-code, regulatory, and real-transaction settings, CAGE removes the in-budget false allows that accurate pointwise gates admit, while keeping a useful fraction of decisions autonomous. When the policy is executable, CAGE-Exact certifies the policy itself; otherwise CAGE-Lip and CAGE-RS certify a learned gate under an explicit, measured fidelity assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAGE框架，用于认证工具型LLM代理在绑定故障和数值漂移下的动作授权安全性。CAGE联合认证类别与数值通道的邻域，消除点式门控错误允许的同时保持决策自主性，并提供精确与近似两种认证方式。
AI.motivation: 工具型LLM代理在运行时权限门控中，通常仅基于观察到的返回值授权动作，但未防护返回值绑定到其来源时的小错误（一个可容许的绑定故障加上有界数值漂移）。作者发现分别认证类别与数值通道并不能组合成联合安全性，这可能导致本应被拒绝的未经授权动作通过检查。
AI.method: CAGE联合认证声明邻域内的候选动作是否保持授权。它精确枚举离散分支，并在每个分支内认证连续扰动。根据策略是否可执行，提供两种模式：CAGE-Exact直接认证策略本身；CAGE-Lip和CAGE-RS在可测量的保真度假设下认证学习得到的门控。
AI.result: 在合成、策略即代码、法规和真实交易等多种场景中，CAGE消除了点式门控在预算内错误允许的案例，同时保持有用比例的决策可自主执行。
AI.conclusion: CAGE为LLM代理的权限门控提供了更安全的联合邻域认证方案，弥补了分别认证类别与数值通道的组合缺陷，在安全性和自主性之间取得了有效平衡。

title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
summary: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpretability that scalar RMs offer. While recent approaches combine both paradigms through off-policy multi-task learning, such parallel optimization does not guarantee that generated reasoning traces actively align with or benefit downstream scalar reward prediction. To address this mismatch, we propose LatentRM, a reward modeling framework that learns intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables to explicitly maximize the likelihood of downstream scalar rewards. Through on-policy optimization of the latent reasoning space end-to-end, LatentRM tightly couples deep reasoning-based evaluation with precise scoring. Extensive validations on in-distribution and OOD datasets and RLHF show that LatentRM outperforms scalar, generative, and hybrid RMs on preference modeling and policy alignment across tasks ranging from open-ended conversation to complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LatentRM，一种将推理轨迹建模为离散潜变量以显式最大化下游标量奖励似然的奖励建模框架，通过端到端的在线策略优化紧密耦合深度推理评估与精确评分，在分布内/分布外数据集及RLHF任务上均优于标量、生成式和混合奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 传统标量奖励模型虽然高效且具有概率可解释性，但依赖表面线索，难以泛化到复杂或分布外任务；生成式奖励模型通过推理提升鲁棒性，但缺乏数值灵活性和概率可解释性；现有混合方法采用离线策略多任务学习，无法保证生成的推理轨迹对下游标量奖励预测产生主动对齐或有益贡献。
AI.method: 提出LatentRM框架，将中间推理轨迹作为离散潜变量进行学习，以显式最大化下游标量奖励的似然；通过端到端的在线策略优化（on-policy optimization）潜推理空间，将基于深度推理的评估与精确评分紧密结合。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外数据集以及RLHF任务上的广泛验证表明，LatentRM在偏好建模和策略对齐方面均优于标量、生成式和混合奖励模型，覆盖从开放式对话到复杂推理的各种任务。
AI.conclusion: LatentRM通过将推理过程与标量评分深度耦合的潜变量建模方式，有效弥合了生成式与标量奖励模型的鸿沟，为奖励建模提供了一种更稳健且可解释的新范式。

title: Learning from Adversity: Semantic-Aware Mask Refinement through Adversarial Perturbation
summary: Despite significant advances in image segmentation, even state-of-the-art models produce masks with imperfect boundaries, semantic inconsistencies, and structural errors. Mask refinement addresses these limitations, yet current approaches rely on simplistic synthetic noise that fails to capture the complex error patterns of real segmentation models. We introduce Phoenix, a novel framework that leverages adversarial learning to generate semantically meaningful noise patterns and contrastive learning to model refinement relationships. Our approach consists of two key innovations: (1) Adversarial Mask Perturbation, which employs embedding attacks to create semantic-aware noise that mimics real segmentation errors, and (2) Contrastive Mask Refinement Learning, which establishes a tri-directional framework that ensures feature consistency within semantic regions while maintaining separation between classes. Experiments demonstrate that Phoenix significantly outperforms existing methods across diverse tasks, while consistently enhancing state-of-the-art segmentation models with substantial improvements. Our code and project page are publicly available at https://phoenix-eccv26.github.io.

AI.tldr: Phoenix是一个利用对抗学习和对比学习进行掩码细化的新框架，通过生成语义感知的噪声模式和三元对比细化学习，显著提升了各种分割模型的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码细化方法依赖简单合成噪声，无法捕捉真实分割模型的复杂错误模式，导致细化效果有限。
AI.method: 两个核心创新：(1) 对抗掩码扰动——通过嵌入攻击生成语义感知噪声，模拟真实分割错误；(2) 对比掩码细化学习——建立三元方向框架，确保语义区域内特征一致性同时保持类间分离。
AI.result: 在多种分割任务上显著优于现有方法，并能持续提升最先进分割模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: Phoenix验证了对抗学习与对比学习相结合的掩码细化范式的有效性，为提升分割模型输出质量提供了可行且可复现的方案。

title: MirrorCraft: Paired Evaluation under Hidden Rule Changes in Minecraft
summary: With the prosperity of the large language models (LLMs), it has become an interesting topic: how do LLM-based agents work in Minecraft? Unfortunately, most existing benchmarks evaluate them under fixed game mechanics. High performance in these settings does not show whether an agent can continue making progress when familiar recipes, drops, and other rules change. In this paper, we introduce MirrorCraft, a paired benchmark for evaluating agents under hidden rule changes in Minecraft. Each Mirror world is a copy of its paired Vanilla world, with selected server-side rules modified by the corresponding datapack. Terrain, spawn, resource placement, objective, interface, and action budget remain matched within every Vanilla-Mirror pair. MirrorCraft includes five controlled biomes, six rule suites, three progression objectives, two model families, and six agent configurations under a shared Mineflayer interface. We evaluate task progress with deterministic advancement milestones and success rate and use the Rule Intervention Effect (RIE) to measure the performance change between matched Vanilla and Mirror worlds. The experiments show that hidden rule changes have strongly different effects across suites. Among the configurations evaluated without rule descriptions, ReAct achieves the highest pooled Mirror score. Providing the exact rules yields modest gains in average progress and completion across all three objectives. MirrorCraft extends Minecraft evaluation beyond fixed mechanics and provides a controlled setting for studying how agents use gameplay outcomes when the rules of the current world differ from familiar ones.

AI.tldr: MirrorCraft是一个配对基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体在Minecraft中面对隐藏规则变化时的表现。每个Mirror世界是Vanilla世界的副本，但服务器端规则被修改，通过规则干预效应(RIE)度量性能变化。
AI.motivation: 现有Minecraft基准测试都在固定游戏机制下评估LLM智能体，无法检验当熟悉配方、掉落物等规则改变时智能体是否仍能继续进步，缺乏评估隐性规则变化下智能体适应能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建配对基准MirrorCraft：每个Mirror世界通过数据包修改选定服务器端规则，与Vanilla世界在地形、出生点、资源分布、目标、界面和行动预算上保持匹配。包含五个受控生物群系、六套规则、三个进展目标、两个模型家族和六种智能体配置，使用确定性里程碑和成功率评估任务进展，并以RIE度量配对世界间的性能变化。
AI.result: 实验表明隐藏规则变化对六套规则的影响差异显著；在无规则描述的配置中，ReAct取得最高的Mirror世界池化分数；提供精确规则描述在三个目标上均带来平均进展和完成率的适度提升。
AI.conclusion: MirrorCraft将Minecraft评估从固定机制扩展到规则可变的场景，为研究智能体在当前世界规则与熟悉规则不一致时如何利用游戏结果进行适应提供了受控实验环境。

title: Detecting Experiential Intertextuality Across Migration Routes: Beyond Surface Similarity in French Narratives
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SIGDIAL 2026 (27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue)
summary: Migrants traversing geographically distinct routes such as the Trans-Saharan and Balkan corridors often recount strikingly parallel lived experiences: police violence, smuggler exploitation, dangerous crossings, and family separation. We introduce the task of experiential intertextuality detection: automatically identifying shared experiential echoes across migration narratives without requiring annotated training data. From 108 French migration narratives spanning both corridors, we automatically generate sentence pairs and score them using annotation-free methods: lexical baselines, sentence embeddings, POS-based structural features, a migration-specific theme lexicon, context-aware narrative features, and zero-shot LLM scoring with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B under three prompting strategies. We validate all methods against 816 expert-annotated intertextuality judgments (inter-annotator Krippendorff's $α= 0.27$). Our results reveal that all surface, structural, and embedding methods correlate only weakly with expert judgments ($r \leq 0.30$); Qwen2.5-7B zero-shot achieves the best single-method correlation ($r = 0.38$); few-shot examples degrade Qwen but dramatically improve Mistral; narrative position significantly predicts intertextuality, with departure-phase pairs showing the highest experiential echoes; and a supervised hybrid combining all 31 features achieves $r = 0.45$, a 21% improvement over the best individual method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"经验性互文性检测"任务，旨在无标注训练数据的情况下自动识别跨移民路线叙事中的共享经验回声。在108篇法语移民叙事上，综合比较了词汇、嵌入、结构、主题词典、上下文特征及零样本LLM等方法，最佳监督混合模型达到r=0.45。
AI.motivation: 来自不同地理路线（如跨撒哈拉和巴尔干走廊）的移民叙事往往呈现惊人的相似经历，但现有方法缺乏自动识别这种"经验性互文性"（experiential intertextuality）的工具，且标注训练数据难以获取。
AI.method: 从108篇法语移民叙事中自动生成句子对，采用多种免标注方法评分：词汇基线、句子嵌入、POS结构特征、移民主题词典、上下文叙事特征，以及三种提示策略下的Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B零样本LLM评分；并构建监督混合模型整合全部31个特征。
AI.result: 表面、结构和嵌入方法与专家判断仅弱相关（r≤0.30）；Qwen2.5-7B零样本最优单方法r=0.38；few-shot对Qwen有损、对Mistral大幅提升；叙事位置显著预测互文性（离境阶段最高）；31特征监督混合模型r=0.45，比最佳单方法提升21%。
AI.conclusion: 经验性互文性检测具有挑战性，传统表面/结构/嵌入方法效果有限，LLM零样本评分更优，叙事位置是重要线索，多特征融合的监督方法能显著提升检测精度。

title: Don't Mix Rewards, Mix Policies: Policy Decomposition and Optimization for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) are expected not just to answer correctly, but to adapt their behavior to different human values and use cases. As a result, multi-reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become an increasingly important problem for LLMs, where each reward captures a different aspect of desired behavior. However, optimizing with multiple rewards suffers from a more severe alignment tax issue, where different optimization objectives can trade off or even conflict with each other, leading to unstable and inefficient post-training. In this work, we propose PRISM, a new multi-reward RL framework built upon the idea of policy-space decomposition and composition. Instead of compositing different rewards, PRISM optimizes a set of standalone positive policies and a global negative policy. This alleviates the potential conflict during multi-reward policy optimization, while enabling controllability during inference by flexible policy composition. Experiments on scientific reasoning, tool-use reasoning, and helpfulness-safety alignment show that PRISM consistently outperforms existing multi-reward RL baselines, with extra controllability for inference-time preference control.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个基于策略空间分解与组合的多奖励强化学习框架，通过优化一组独立正向策略和一个全局负向策略来缓解多奖励优化中的对齐税问题，并在推理时实现可控的策略组合。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型需要同时适配不同的人类价值和用例，多奖励强化学习变得日益重要。然而多奖励优化存在更严重的对齐税问题，不同优化目标之间可能相互权衡甚至冲突，导致训练不稳定且效率低下。
AI.method: PRISM框架采用策略空间分解与组合的思路，不直接组合不同奖励，而是优化一组独立的正向策略和一个全局负向策略，从而缓解多奖励策略优化中的潜在冲突，并在推理阶段通过灵活的策略组合实现可控性。
AI.result: 在科学推理、工具使用推理和Helpfulness-Safety对齐三个实验场景中，PRISM一致性地优于现有的多奖励强化学习基线方法，并额外提供了推理时偏好控制的能力。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过策略空间的分解与组合有效解决了多奖励RL中的对齐税问题，不仅提升了性能，还带来了推理阶段的可控性，为多奖励LLM后训练提供了一种新的有效范式。

title: Hy-MultiTurn: A Six-Dimensional Benchmark for Deep Multi-Turn Dialogue Understanding
summary: Long-running multi-turn interactions with chatbots and agents are now common, and a correct response often depends on remembering earlier details, tracking later revisions, identifying intended objects or referents, and withholding action when required conditions are unmet. Existing multi-turn benchmarks typically cover short exchanges and do not fully evaluate these capabilities in long multi-turn interactions, particularly in Chinese, while offering limited insight into how and why models fail. To address these limitations, we analyze real chatbot failures to identify six recurring mechanisms and use them to define six controlled evaluation modes in Hy-MultiTurn, a Chinese benchmark for deep multi-turn dialogue understanding. The six modes evaluate constraint memory, precise execution, constraint synthesis, object localization, action suppression, and reference resolution. Across the six modes, we construct 209 controlled tasks spanning 12-76 turns, with dialogue length, irrelevant-topic distraction, and colloquial phrasing adding further difficulty. Evaluation of 22 frontier model configurations shows that Hy-MultiTurn is broadly challenging, as even GPT-5.5, the strongest overall configuration, satisfies all requirements in only 41.1 percent of responses and no model performs best in all six modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hy-MultiTurn，一个中文深度多轮对话理解基准，包含六种受控评估模式和209个跨12-76轮的任务，评估22个前沿模型配置后发现即使最强的GPT-5.5也仅有41.1%的响应满足所有要求。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮对话基准通常覆盖短对话，未能充分评估长多轮交互中记忆、修订跟踪、指代识别和条件抑制等能力，尤其是在中文场景下，且对模型失败原因缺乏深入分析。
AI.method: 通过分析真实聊天机器人失败案例，识别出六种重复出现的失败机制，并据此定义六种受控评估模式：约束记忆、精确执行、约束综合、对象定位、动作抑制和指代消解。构建了209个受控任务，跨度12-76轮，并加入对话长度、无关话题干扰和口语化表达以增加难度。
AI.result: 评估22个前沿模型配置发现该基准具有广泛挑战性，最强配置GPT-5.5在所有要求下的满足率仅为41.1%，且没有任何模型在全部六种模式下均表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: Hy-MultiTurn有效填补了中文长多轮对话深度理解评估的空白，揭示了现有前沿模型在长时间多轮交互中的显著不足，并为后续模型改进提供了细粒度的能力诊断框架。

title: Forwardrobe: Garment-Aware Gaussian Avatars from a Single Image
summary: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from a single image remains particularly challenging for loose garments, whose geometry and motion cannot be adequately represented by body-aligned topology and skinning. We present Forwardrobe, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing garment-aware Gaussian avatars from a single image. Forwardrobe explicitly separates clothing from the body in canonical Gaussian space and equips the garment layer with continuity-aware geometry and skinning initialization, pose-conditioned non-rigid deformation, and appearance adaptation. These designs improve garment reconstruction and visual quality during animation, particularly for skirts and dresses. The separated garment layer additionally forms an independently controllable 3D asset, enabling garment editing, transfer, and 3D virtual try-on. Experiments demonstrate improved garment reconstruction quality and greater flexibility in garment manipulation compared with existing single-image avatar reconstruction methods.

AI.tldr: Forwardrobe是一个从单张图像重建可动画化3D人体化身的前馈框架，专门解决宽松衣物（如裙子、连衣裙）的几何和运动表示难题。该方法在规范高斯空间中显式分离衣物与身体，并为衣物层配备连续性感知的几何与蒙皮初始化、姿态条件非刚性形变和外观自适应，从而提升衣物重建质量与动画视觉效果。
