AI.motivation: 现有的单图3D人体化身重建方法通常采用身体对齐的拓扑和蒙皮来表示衣物，无法充分表达宽松衣物的几何结构和运动特征，导致重建质量不佳。因此需要一种能够显式建模衣物的方法。
AI.method: Forwardrobe采用前馈式框架，核心设计包括：1) 在规范高斯空间中显式分离衣物层与身体层；2) 为衣物层提供连续性感知的几何和蒙皮初始化；3) 引入姿态条件非刚性形变机制；4) 实现外观自适应调整。
AI.result: 实验表明，与现有的单图化身重建方法相比，Forwardrobe在衣物重建质量和动画效果方面均有提升，尤其在裙子和连衣裙等宽松衣物上表现突出。分离出的衣物层可独立控制，支持衣物编辑、迁移和3D虚拟试穿。
AI.conclusion: Forwardrobe通过显式分离衣物与身体并在高斯空间中引入针对衣物的专用建模策略，有效解决了宽松衣物的重建与动画难题，同时提供了灵活可控的3D衣物资产管理能力。

title: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents
summary: AI agents extend large language models (LLMs) with external tools, enabling them to perform complex tasks and translate model outputs into consequential real-world actions. Yet LLMs often become substantially less safe when deployed as agents, and the source of this degradation remains poorly understood. In this paper, we identify schema-formatted tool specifications as a primary source of agent safety degradation and show, through white-box representation analysis, that they weaken the model's internal refusal signals and contribute to unsafe tool execution. Building on this finding, we propose SafeKeep, an inference-time safeguard that decouples safety judgment from tool execution: it assesses requests using flattened textual tool specifications while retaining the original schema-formatted specifications for execution. Across two representative benchmarks and four LLMs, including both white-box and black-box models, SafeKeep increases the average refusal rate for harmful requests from 23.8% to 70.6% and reduces the average attack success rate under observation-level prompt injection from 25.6% to 2.5%. It also outperforms existing safeguards and preserves task-handling capability. We release the code and data at https://github.com/snowcatsmoking/SafeKeep .

AI.tldr: 本文发现schema格式的工具规格说明是LLM作为AI代理时安全性下降的主要原因，并提出推理时安全防护方法SafeKeep，通过将安全性判断与工具执行解耦（使用扁平化文本工具规格进行评估，保留原始schema格式用于执行），在四个LLM和两个基准上显著提升了对有害请求的拒绝率（从23.8%提升至70.6%）并大幅降低了提示注入攻击成功率（从25.6%降至2.5%）。
AI.motivation: LLM在部署为AI代理时会明显变得不那么安全，但其安全退化的原因尚未被充分理解。作者希望通过白盒表征分析找到安全性下降的根本来源，从而设计有效的防护机制。
AI.method: 首先通过白盒表征分析揭示schema格式工具规格削弱了模型内部的拒绝信号，导致不安全工具执行。基于此提出SafeKeep，一个推理时安全防护方法，核心思想是将安全判断从工具执行中解耦：评估请求时使用扁平化文本工具规格，而实际执行时保留原始schema格式规格。
AI.result: 在四个LLM（包括白盒和黑盒模型）和两个代表性基准上，SafeKeep将有害请求的平均拒绝率从23.8%提升到70.6%，将观察级提示注入的平均攻击成功率从25.6%降低到2.5%，同时优于现有防护方法并保持任务处理能力。
AI.conclusion: schema格式的工具规格是AI代理安全退化的关键来源，通过解耦安全判断与工具执行的方式，SafeKeep能够在不大幅损失功能的情况下有效提升AI代理的安全性。

title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
summary: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle errors, escalating with task difficulty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{CaRL} (\textbf{Ca}pability-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning), which aligns model behavior with capability boundaries through reward shaping that incentivizes refusal over futile reasoning and hindsight refusal augmentation that converts failures into refusal supervision. Experiments demonstrate a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties, effectively achieving capability-aligned behavior without sacrificing utility. \footnote{https://github.com/icip-cas/Knowing-When-to-Quit}

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在超出能力范围的任务上产生"徒劳推理"（futile reasoning）的问题，提出了CaRL（能力对齐强化学习）方法，通过奖励塑形和事后拒绝增强来使模型行为与自身能力边界对齐，在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅减少徒劳推理。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在超出其能力范围的任务上会产生计算开销巨大但语义空洞的推理，这些看似合理却包含错误的推导会误导用户。现有方法未系统解决模型"能力与行为不匹配"的问题。
AI.method: 提出CaRL框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 奖励塑形（reward shaping），通过激励模型拒绝回答而非进行徒劳推理来对齐能力边界；(2) 事后拒绝增强（hindsight refusal augmentation），将失败的推理输出转化为拒绝监督信号。该方法通过系统分析揭示了徒劳推理的普遍性和能力过度扩展现象。
AI.result: 实验表明CaRL在各类任务难度上显著减少了徒劳推理现象，同时保持了原有任务性能，有效实现了能力对齐的行为而无需牺牲实用性。
AI.conclusion: 徒劳推理是大语言模型的系统性缺陷，主要失败模式是表面有效但含有微妙错误的"虚妄推理"（specious reasoning）。CaRL证明了通过能力对齐的强化学习可以有效地让模型"知道何时该停止"，从而在保持性能的同时降低误导用户的风险。

title: A Frozen Pixel-Space Diffusion Model Can Guide Itself with Its Own Samples
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models aim to learn an end-to-end generator directly over raw pixels. This is challenging because a single model must capture both global structure and local texture in the same high-dimensional space. While recent work improves pixel diffusion through alternative prediction targets, training objectives, and architectures, these advances typically require training a new model from scratch. We show there is a cheaper, complementary strategy: \textbf{a frozen, pretrained pixel diffusion model can guide itself}. Our key observation is that intermediate layers of a pretrained pixel diffusion transformer can be decoded into coarse predictions that capture the main low-frequency structure, while the final layers progressively refine local, high-frequency details. We therefore attach a lightweight prediction head to an intermediate layer, keep the backbone frozen, and use the discrepancy between the intermediate and final predictions as a self-guidance direction during sampling. To train this head, we further find that real images are not necessary. Instead, model-generated samples suffice and even outperform real images for training the head, especially in enhancing the high-frequency components that pixel diffusion tends to underfit. Across multiple pixel diffusion models on ImageNet, our \textbf{Synthetic Self-Guidance (SSG)} consistently improves generation while adapter training requires less than 1$\%$ of full-model training compute: it reduces FID by over 50$\%$ across the evaluated JiT variants without classifier-free guidance (CFG) and further improves strong baselines with CFG, e.g., JiT-H/16 from 1.86 to 1.67 and PixelREPA-H/16 from 1.81 to 1.59. Our code is available at https://github.com/zfu006/SSG.

AI.tldr: 提出合成自引导（SSG）方法，利用冻结的预训练像素空间扩散模型中间层与最终层的预测差异作为引导方向，无需从头训练即可显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型需要同时捕捉全局结构和局部纹理，现有改进方法（如替代预测目标、训练目标、架构）通常需要从头训练新模型，成本高昂。本文探索一种更便宜的策略：利用冻结的预训练模型进行自我引导。
AI.method: 核心发现是预训练像素扩散Transformer的中间层可解码为捕获低频结构的粗略预测，最终层逐步细化高频细节。方法是在中间层附加轻量级预测头，保持骨干网络冻结，利用中间层与最终层预测之间的差异作为采样时的自引导方向。训练该预测头时不需要真实图像，模型生成的样本即可，甚至比真实图像效果更好，尤其能增强像素扩散容易欠拟合的高频成分。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上多个像素扩散模型上，SSG一致地提升生成质量，适配器训练计算量不到全模型训练的1%。无CFG时JiT变体的FID降低超过50%；有CFG时进一步改善强基线，如JiT-H/16从1.86降至1.67，PixelREPA-H/16从1.81降至1.59。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的预训练像素扩散模型可以通过内部中间层与最终层的预测差异实现自我引导，是一种低成本且高效的补充策略，且合成数据可用于训练引导头。

title: MAGA: Multi-Platform Self-Fusion of GUI Agents via Structured Action Distillation
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents based on large language models are increasingly deployed across mobile, web, and desktop environments. However, existing agents are typically domain-specific, limiting the deployment and user experience. This motivates the consolidation of specialized models into a single cross-environment policy. Weight merging directly merges domain-specific experts but can corrupt executable actions under expert disagreement, while on-policy distillation (OPD) avoids conflicting teacher supervision yet still treats all response tokens equally during distillation, ignoring that action tokens are the only interface between the environment and the agent. To address this, We introduce MAGA that re-allocates training signal according to the structured action. Based on the correctness of the generated action, it suppresses unnecessary or invalid distillation signals and focuses learning on erroneous actions. Besides, a training-only hint optimizes the supervision signal provided by domain-specific teachers without changing the student input. Across two model scales, MAGA achieves the highest mean success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.0% at 8B and achieves almost the same average performance with teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAGA方法，通过根据结构化动作的正确性重新分配训练信号，并引入训练时的提示来优化教师监督信号，实现跨环境（移动、网页、桌面）的GUI代理知识整合，在两个模型规模上均取得最优平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的GUI代理通常是领域特定的（仅针对移动、网页或桌面），限制了部署和用户体验。虽然可以将领域专家模型合并为单一跨环境策略，但权重合并可能在专家意见分歧时损坏可执行动作，而在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽避免了冲突的教师监督，却将所有响应token同等对待，忽视了动作token是代理与环境交互的唯一接口这一关键特性。
AI.method: 提出MAGA框架：(1) 根据生成动作的正确性重新分配训练信号，抑制不必要或无效的蒸馏信号，聚焦于错误动作的学习；(2) 引入训练专用的提示（training-only hint）来优化领域特定教师提供的监督信号，同时不改变学生输入。
AI.result: 在两个模型规模上，MAGA均取得最高平均成功率：在8B规模下超过最强基线2.0%，并且几乎达到与教师模型相当的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过对动作token施加结构化、有区分的训练信号分配，MAGA有效地整合了多个领域特定的GUI代理知识，显著优于现有基线方法，为构建统一跨环境GUI代理提供了可行方案。

title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
summary: InMyStyle is a privacy first, single user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine tunes LoRA adapters on base models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. On 219 evaluation pairs from a scientific-paper corpus, the automatic composite score plateaus at 0.69 [scale 0-1] across all model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding. This observed plateau suggests that small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, with model size determining trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-AI generated inputs, while mean perceived AI-ness scores decrease with model size within InMyStyle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InMyStyle系统，一个隐私优先的单用户系统，通过小型语言模型将AI编辑的文本改写为个人写作风格，推理时无需指令提示词。在219个科学论文评估对上，自动综合评分在0.5B至7B所有模型规模下均稳定在0.69，表明小模型足以胜任该改写任务。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助写作工具输出的文本缺乏个性化风格，用户需要一种无需在推理阶段提供额外指令提示词、且能保护隐私的方式，使AI编辑后的文本自动适配个人写作风格。
AI.method: 利用用户的个人文档，通过多个本地辅助LLM构建配对训练样本，在0.5B至7B参数的基础模型上微调LoRA适配器。系统支持长度感知生成预算和自动文本分块，以适应不同长度的输入。
AI.result: 在219个科学论文评估对上，自动综合评分在所有模型规模下（贪心解码和采样解码）均稳定在0.69。400个来自五个LLM评审员的评分显示，InMyStyle输出的平均感知AI-ness分数比辅助AI生成的输入低20%以上，且感知AI-ness分数随模型规模减小而降低。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模不决定稳定的质量排名，而是提供权衡取舍；小模型足以完成测量的改写任务。InMyStyle能有效降低文本的AI感知度，使其更贴近用户个人风格。

title: SciFigPlag-Bench: A Benchmark for Provenance-Aware Scientific Figure Plagiarism Detection
summary: Scientific figures often encode the visual evidence behind scientific findings, yet figure plagiarism remains underexplored as a benchmarked multimodal evaluation problem. We present SciFigPlag-Bench, a benchmark for provenance-aware reasoning over scientific figures in scholarly documents. Unlike general image-similarity or image-forensics benchmarks, SciFigPlag-Bench evaluates whether a suspicious figure reuses evidence from a specific source figure, how the reused content has been transformed, and where the reused evidence appears. We introduce a factorized taxonomy that separates what is reused from how it is transformed, covering material-preserving reuse, such as full-figure and subfigure reuse, as well as abstract-content reuse, such as data re-expression and structural redraw. Guided by this taxonomy, we construct a hybrid benchmark with 2,582 positive pairs and 2,541 negative pairs, combining documented real-world cases, taxonomy-guided synthetic examples, and visually similar negatives. The benchmark supports four diagnostic tasks: pairwise detection, source attribution, hierarchical reuse-type classification, and reuse correspondence localization. Experiments with diverse vision-language models establish initial baselines and reveal persistent challenges in fine-grained provenance reasoning, reuse-type understanding, and spatial evidence grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SciFigPlag-Bench，一个用于学术文献中科学图表抄袭检测与溯源推理的基准评测集，包含5,000+图文对和四个诊断任务，实验表明现有视觉语言模型在细粒度溯源推理上仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 科学图表承载着研究发现的关键视觉证据，但图表抄袭作为一个多模态评测问题尚未被充分研究。现有的图像相似度或图像取证基准无法回答"可疑图表是否复用了特定源图表的证据、如何变换、证据出现在哪里"这类溯源推理问题。
AI.method: 提出因子化分类法，区分"复用内容"（材料保留型复用：整图/子图复用；抽象内容复用：数据重表达/结构重绘）与"变换方式"。基于此分类法构建混合基准，包含2,582个正样本对和2,541个负样本对，融合了真实案例、分类法引导的合成样本和视觉相似的负样本。支持四个诊断任务：成对检测、来源归因、层级式复用类型分类和复用对应定位。
AI.result: 通过多种视觉语言模型的实验建立了初始基线，揭示了模型在细粒度溯源推理、复用类型理解和空间证据定位方面仍存在持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: SciFigPlag-Bench填补了科学图表抄袭评测的空白，为溯源感知的图表推理提供了系统化基准，但当前模型在此任务上的表现仍有较大提升空间。

title: Data Turnstile: A Scalable Open Framework for Function-Calling Data Generation
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive for agentic deployment due to low latency, reduced cost, and on-device privacy, yet they struggle with tool-use tasks where training data is scarce and noisy. Unlike larger models, SLMs cannot compensate for low-quality supervision through sheer capacity, making data quality the critical bottleneck. We present Data Turnstile, an open-source framework that takes user-defined API specifications and generates high-quality synthetic training data for function calling. Turnstile decomposes multi-turn tool-use interactions into constrained, stepwise generation with validation and error-feedback loops, providing fine-grained control over API diversity, conversation complexity, and output correctness. We demonstrate effectiveness of domain adaptation with Turnstile data on two challenging function calling benchmarks. On the BFCL single-turn benchmark, a Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuned on Turnstile data without chain-of-thought achieves 75.9% overall accuracy (versus 67.4% for the base model with thinking enabled), closing the gap with thinking-enabled Qwen3-1.7B (78.4%) and Qwen3-4B (79.9%) despite being 3$\times$ and 7$\times$ smaller respectively. On $τ^2$-bench, a multi-turn agentic benchmark, Turnstile-trained Qwen3-1.7B achieves 31.1% pass^1 on the Telecom domain, improving 4.7$\times$ over its 6.6% base and surpassing Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (27.4%), a model 19$\times$ larger. Turnstile-trained Qwen3-0.6B achieves 24.6%, improving 7$\times$ over its 3.5% base and approaching the 32B model (53$\times$ larger). We release Data Turnstile along with a dataset spanning 1,000+ APIs and 100K+ multi-turn interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Data Turnstile，一个开源框架，通过将多轮工具调用分解为受限的逐步生成过程并加入验证和错误反馈循环，为小型语言模型生成高质量的函数调用合成训练数据，在多个基准上显著提升了SLM的工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型(SLM)在agentic部署中具有低延迟、低成本、隐私保护等优势，但在工具使用任务上表现不佳，因为训练数据稀缺且噪声大。与大型模型不同，SLM无法通过模型容量弥补低质量监督，因此数据质量成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: Data Turnstile框架接收用户定义的API规范，通过将多轮工具交互分解为受限的逐步生成过程，并结合验证和错误反馈循环，生成高质量函数调用合成训练数据。框架对API多样性、对话复杂度和输出正确性提供细粒度控制。
AI.result: 在BFCL单轮基准上，基于Turnstile数据微调的Qwen3-0.6B无需思维链即达到75.9%准确率，超过启用思考的基础模型(67.4%)，逼近更大的Qwen3-1.7B(78.4%)和Qwen3-4B(79.9%)。在τ²-bench多轮基准的Telecom领域，Turnstile训练的Qwen3-1.7B达到31.1%，较基础模型提升4.7倍，超过大19倍的Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct(27.4%)。
AI.conclusion: Data Turnstile有效解决了SLM在工具使用任务中的数据质量瓶颈问题，证明通过精细化数据生成可以显著缩小SLM与大型模型之间的性能差距。框架和数据集（1000+ API、100K+多轮交互）已开源发布。

title: ModelEquivBench: Certifying Multi-Relational Evaluation of LLM-Generated Optimization Models
summary: Large language models increasingly generate optimization models from natural language, but existing evaluation often reduces a generated model and its ground truth to a single equivalent/not-equivalent verdict or an execution-success rate--labels that are neither independently checkable nor faithful to the multiple distinct senses in which two formulations can agree. We present ModelEquivBench, a certifying, multi-relational evaluation system that reports a per-pair semantic profile E0--E6: model construction and exact ingestion (E0), verified representation alignment (E1), same-space and projected feasible-set relations (E2, E3), objective-order equivalence (E4), optimal-value equality (E5), and optimizer-set equivalence (E6). Each decided entry carries relation-appropriate, independently re-checkable evidence: replayable traces or explicit maps for E0--E1, exact-rational certificates for positive E2--E6 conclusions, and explicit witnesses for supported negatives. Incomplete mapping search, unsupported structure, and resource limits produce typed UNKNOWN or N/A outcomes rather than guesses, while unmet prerequisites are reported as ABSENT. Using ModelEquivBench to evaluate three model snapshots--GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B--on the same frozen cohort of 173 base problems (346 cells per model) under a no-repair protocol, the resulting profiles expose distinctions that coarse baselines do not represent: 49, 35, and 25 cells contain executable candidates that are nevertheless certified negative on at least one supported relation, and 25, 8, and 18 structural rejections occur on pairs for which E2 certifies mapped feasible-set equality under a verified map. The three model snapshots fail at different stages of the profile and therefore cannot be meaningfully reduced to a single accuracy score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ModelEquivBench，一个可认证、多关系的模型等价性评估系统，通过E0—E6七级语义剖面报告优化模型生成对之间的等价关系，每条判定都附带可独立复核的证据，并在三个大模型快照上展示了粗粒度基线无法捕捉的差异化评估结果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成优化模型的评估方法要么将生成模型与标准答案简化为单一等价/不等价的二元判定，要么只报告执行成功率，但这些标签既不可独立验证，也无法忠实反映两个公式在多种不同意义上的"一致"关系。
AI.method: 设计多关系评估系统ModelEquivBench，定义E0—E6七级语义剖面（包括模型构造与精确摄取、验证的表示对齐、同空间及投影可行域关系、目标函数阶等价、最优值等价、优化器集合等价）。每条判定附带相应证据：E0—E1提供可重放追踪或显式映射，正面的E2—E6结论提供精确有理数证书，支持的负面结论提供显式反例见证；不支持的情况给出UNKNOWN或N/A，前置条件未满足时报告ABSENT。在173个基础问题（每模型346个单元）上对三个模型快照进行无修复协议评估。
AI.result: 三个模型快照（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）分别在49、35、25个单元中包含可执行候选但至少在一个支持关系上被认证为负面；在25、8、18个结构拒绝发生于E2验证映射可行域等价的配对。三个模型在不同剖面阶段失败，无法简化为单一准确率得分。
AI.conclusion: ModelEquivBench证明了LLM生成的优化模型需要多关系的细粒度评估，单维度的等价判定或执行成功率无法反映模型间在不同语义层面的实质差异。

title: CalibratedRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubric Banks for Open-Ended LLM Evaluation
summary: Reliable evaluation of open-ended LLM outputs requires fine-grained rubrics, yet expert curation is costly and difficult to scale. Existing automated pipelines rely on strict judge unanimity and binary variance filters, which cannot distinguish measurable rubrics from informative ones. We introduce CalibratedRubric, a task-adaptive framework that combines type-specific scoring, Bayesian rubric-measurability filtering, and item response theory (IRT)-based bank assembly. CalibratedRubric estimates each rubric's measurability with a Beta--Bernoulli agreement posterior and uses a submodular information-coverage objective to construct compact rubric banks over the observed capability range. Across financial, healthcare, general, and legal benchmarks, measurability filtering improves human-gold agreement on JudgmentBench from $κ=0.604$ to $0.743$. IRT-based greedy selection improves cross-fitted rank fidelity over random selection across all six evaluated response blocks and requires only 49 rather than 131 rubrics to reach the target correlation on FinResearchBench decision-support tasks. Task-label perturbations further reduce system separation, confirming the practical relevance of task-adaptive scoring. These results support CalibratedRubric as an efficient, uncertainty-aware approach to open-ended LLM evaluation, with calibration gains depending on sufficient judge redundancy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CalibratedRubric框架，通过类型特定评分、贝叶斯可测量性过滤和基于项目反应理论（IRT）的题库组装，实现高效、任务自适应的开放式大语言模型评估，在多个基准上显著提升评估一致性和效率。
AI.motivation: 开放式LLM输出的可靠评估需要细粒度评分标准，但专家人工构建成本高昂且难以规模化。现有自动化管线依赖严格的评委一致性投票和二值方差过滤，无法区分可测量与信息丰富的评分标准，亟需更智能的自适应评估方法。
AI.method: CalibratedRubric包含三个核心组件：1）类型特定评分（type-specific scoring）；2）基于Beta-Bernoulli协议后验的贝叶斯评分标准可测量性过滤；3）基于子模信息覆盖目标函数和IRT的贪心题库组装策略，在观测能力范围内构建紧凑的评分标准库。
AI.result: 在金融、医疗、通用和法律基准上，可测量性过滤将JudgmentBench的人类-金标准一致性从κ=0.604提升至0.743；IRT贪心选择在所有六个评估响应块上优于随机选择的交叉拟合排序保真度，在FinResearchBench决策支持任务上仅需49个而非131个评分标准即可达到目标相关性。任务标签扰动降低了系统分离度，验证了任务自适应评分的实际意义。
AI.conclusion: CalibratedRubric是一种高效、不确定性感知的开放式LLM评估方法，校准收益取决于足够的评委冗余度，为大规模LLM评估提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
summary: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring multimodal observations into queryable structures supporting filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison. We present AdaMM, a framework that jointly supports retrieval and analytic memory. Rather than relying on application-defined schemas, AdaMM extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, and materializes them for analytical access. At inference time, a memory-aware planner decomposes queries into retrieval and analytic operations and routes each operation to the appropriate tools. Experiments on two long-term multimodal memory benchmarks, MemEye and MemGallery, show that AdaMM improves performance by up to 11.3\% and 7.3\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaMM框架，在传统检索式记忆之外引入"分析记忆"概念，将多模态交互历史中的重复观测组织为可查询的结构化数据，支持过滤、聚合、排序和时间比较等分析操作。在MemEye和MemGallery两个基准上分别提升11.3%和7.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有长期多模态记忆系统主要侧重于检索式记忆，通过摘要和索引组织交互历史以返回查询相关信息，但无法支持跨交互累积观测的计算操作（如过滤、聚合、排序和时序比较），缺乏分析型记忆的建模。
AI.method: 提出AdaMM框架，联合支持检索记忆和分析记忆。具体包括：(1) 从对话、图像和上下文元数据中提取带有溯源链接的属性-值观测；(2) 自动发现重复出现的字段结构并物化为可分析访问的结构；(3) 推理阶段使用记忆感知规划器将查询分解为检索和分析操作，并路由到相应工具执行。
AI.result: 在两个长期多模态记忆基准MemEye和MemGallery上的实验表明，AdaMM相比基线分别提升了11.3%和7.3%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 分析记忆是对检索记忆的重要补充，AdaMM通过自动提取和物化结构化观测，使多模态记忆系统能够同时支持信息检索和跨观测的分析计算，从而更全面地满足长期交互场景下的记忆需求。

title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation
comment: 34 pages, 17 figures, and 21 tables. Accepted to ACL 2026
summary: Multi-domain machine translation (MDMT) poses a unique challenge due to varying levels of linguistic complexity across domains. Inspired by human translators' ability to adapt reasoning effort based on difficulty, we propose TwT (Translation with Thought), a resource-rational framework that learns to modulate inference between intuitive and deliberate reasoning. TwT is trained in two stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-aware long chain-of-thought traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and rewritten by GPT-4o to reflect human-like reasoning economy, and (2) reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward to optimize translation quality and reasoning efficiency. Evaluated on 15 benchmarks spanning in-domain and out-of-domain settings, as well as 3 seen and 59 unseen languages, with ablations across three backbone models, TwT-7B and TwT-14B outperform much larger SOTA reasoning models in translation quality, while reducing token usage by 32--60\%. These results confirm that aligning translation behavior with cognitive principles enables robust generalization, high translation quality, and efficient reasoning in MDMT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwT（Translation with Thought）框架，通过资源理性机制在直觉推理与深思熟虑推理之间动态调节，以解决多领域机器翻译（MDMT）中不同领域语言复杂度差异的问题。TwT-7B和TwT-14B在15个基准和62种语言上超越了更大的SOTA推理模型，同时减少了32-60%的token使用量。
AI.motivation: 多领域机器翻译面临不同领域语言复杂度差异显著的挑战，传统方法无法根据翻译难度自适应地调节推理投入。作者借鉴人类译者根据翻译难度调整推理努力的能力，希望构建一个资源理性的翻译框架，在保证翻译质量的同时实现推理效率的最优化。
AI.method: TwT采用两阶段训练：（1）监督微调阶段，使用从DeepSeek-R1蒸馏并由GPT-4o重写的、体现人类推理经济性的难度感知长思维链轨迹数据；（2）强化学习阶段，采用混合奖励函数同时优化翻译质量和推理效率。
AI.result: 在15个基准（涵盖域内和域外场景）、3种已见语言和59种未见语言的评估中，TwT-7B和TwT-14B在翻译质量上超越了更大的SOTA推理模型，同时将token使用量减少了32-60%。
AI.conclusion: 将翻译行为与认知原则对齐能够实现MDMT中的鲁棒泛化、高质量翻译和高效推理，验证了资源理性推理在机器翻译任务中的有效性。

title: Have I Seen You? Embedding Behavior Signals Synthetic Face Dataset Membership
summary: Synthetic face datasets are increasingly used to reduce privacy exposure and data access constraints in biometric recognition. Yet the generators that produce these datasets are trained on real faces, so synthetic data may still reveal their real source data. We study this risk through a dataset-level membership inference attack that first identifies the synthetic dataset used to train a face recognizer and then infers the real dataset used to train the generator. Across 11 face recognition models, 11 synthetic datasets, and 7 real datasets, the attack recovers the synthetic training dataset in 100% of cases and identifies the generator's source dataset in 54.5% of cases. These results show that synthetic data can retain dataset-level traces of real training data and that privacy-preserving deployment requires stronger leakage mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数据集级别的成员推理攻击，揭示了合成人脸数据集仍可能泄露其训练生成器所用的真实人脸数据。在11个面部识别模型、11个合成数据集和7个真实数据集上，攻击在100%的情况下恢复了合成训练数据集，并在54.5%的情况下识别出生成器的真实来源数据集。
AI.motivation: 合成人脸数据集被广泛用于减少隐私暴露和数据访问限制，但生成器本身是在真实人脸数据上训练的，因此合成数据可能仍然泄露其真实的来源数据，这构成了潜在的隐私风险。
AI.method: 提出一种数据集级别的成员推理攻击方法，分两步进行：首先识别用于训练面部识别模型的合成数据集，然后推断用于训练生成器的真实数据集。
AI.result: 在11个面部识别模型、11个合成数据集和7个真实数据集的广泛实验中，攻击在100%的情况下恢复了合成训练数据集，并在54.5%的情况下成功识别出生成器的来源真实数据集。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据会保留真实训练数据的数据集级痕迹，现有隐私保护部署需要更强的泄漏缓解措施来应对此类风险。

title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
summary: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while a separately parameterized solver alone retrieves skills. Informative failures are distilled into reusable skills and written back to memory. The updated memory changes solver behavior and success, which changes the challenger's reward and the distribution of future problems; the resulting frontier produces new failures that rewrite memory. This bidirectional loop makes task generation and skill memory co-evolve. Because retrieved skills shape on-policy training trajectories, their benefits can enter the model parameters as well as remain in the external bank, enabling memory-free deployment and optional inference-time retrieval. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, SESA improves average accuracy over SSP by 1.2--3.2 points across multiple backbones and surpasses the skill-augmented SkillRL baseline by 0.9 points under a unified evaluation protocol. On Qwen3 models, SESA-Off retains 1.8--2.2 points of improvement over SSP, while the final skill bank adds a further 0.5--1.0 points. These results show that evolving skill memory is not merely an inference-time plug-in: it changes policy learning and the future training distribution while retaining value as optional external memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SESA-Self-Evolving-Search-Agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SESA（自进化技能增强智能体），通过工具增强的搜索自对弈机制，让任务生成与技能记忆相互演化，在七个问答基准上超越现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 自对弈智能体生成的训练问题缺乏持久状态，失败虽然影响梯度但不会显式塑造未来的练习分布；外部技能记忆虽然保留程序性经验，但通常从固定任务分布中学习。需要一种机制让技能记忆成为演化状态，而非静态存储。
AI.method: SESA包含一个挑战者生成问题，以及一个独立参数化的求解器负责检索技能。信息性失败被提炼为可复用技能并写回记忆库；更新的记忆改变求解器行为和成功率，进而改变挑战者的奖励和未来问题分布。这种双向循环使任务生成和技能记忆共同演化，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在七个开放域和多跳问答基准上，SESA相比SSP在不同骨干模型上平均提升1.2-3.2个准确率点；在统一评估协议下超越SkillRL基线0.9个点。在Qwen3模型上，SESA-Off相比SSP保留1.8-2.2个点的提升，技能库额外贡献0.5-1.0个点。
AI.conclusion: 演化技能记忆不仅仅是推断时的插件，它改变策略学习和未来训练分布，同时保留作为可选外部记忆的价值，支持无记忆部署和可选的推断时检索。

title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Machine Translation in Turkic Languages
summary: Cross-lingual transfer is central to low-resource machine translation, but its behavior within closely related language families remains insufficiently characterized. We study transfer among five Turkic languages; Turkish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Kazakh, and Kyrgyz; using pairwise transfer matrices. In this setting, each model is fine-tuned with one transfer source and evaluated on a different transfer target while the translation target remains the same. Across mT5 experiments, we find that transfer is strongest between closely related Turkic pairs, especially Turkish-Azerbaijani and Kazakh-Kyrgyz. We also show that transfer direction matters, and that the same transfer source-transfer target pair can behave differently when the translation target changes. Latinization improves BLEU and chrF in several script-mismatched settings, but its effect is not uniform across metrics. Additional analyses show that transfer sources are mostly stable across different datasets and model settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了五种突厥语系语言（土耳其语、阿塞拜疆语、乌兹别克语、哈萨克语、吉尔吉斯语）之间的跨语言迁移行为，通过成对迁移矩阵发现迁移在亲缘关系密切的语言对（如土耳其语-阿塞拜疆语、哈萨克语-吉尔吉斯语）中最强，同时迁移方向、翻译目标及拉丁化处理都会影响迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移对低资源机器翻译至关重要，但在亲缘关系密切的语言家族内部，其行为特征尚未得到充分刻画，需要系统性研究以理解迁移机制。
AI.method: 在mT5模型上，对五种突厥语语言进行成对迁移实验：每个模型用一个迁移源语言微调，在另一个迁移目标语言上评估，翻译目标保持不变。构建成对迁移矩阵，并分析拉丁化、迁移方向等因素的影响。
AI.result: 迁移在亲缘关系密切的突厥语对中最强，尤其是土耳其语-阿塞拜疆语和哈萨克语-吉尔吉斯语；迁移方向会影响结果；同一迁移源-目标对在不同翻译目标下表现不同；拉丁化在多种脚本不匹配场景下提升BLEU和chrF，但并非所有指标都一致改善；迁移源在不同数据集和模型设置下总体稳定。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言迁移在突厥语内部表现出与亲缘关系高度相关的模式，迁移方向性和翻译目标依赖性显著，拉丁化可作为脚本不匹配时的有效辅助手段，但需谨慎评估其在不同指标上的效果。

title: Progressive Decision-Making for Localizing Open-Ended AI-Generated Image Forgeries
summary: AI-generated image forgeries are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to characterize with fixed manipulation patterns. As generative models continue to evolve, it is impractical to expect a localization model to exhaustively learn all possible forgery appearances from large-scale training data alone. Nevertheless, many AI-generated forgeries still leave subtle forensic traces, although these cues are often weak and unevenly reliable across regions. Therefore, robust localization requires not only extracting informative forensic traces, but also making reliable decisions from incomplete and ambiguous evidence. In this paper, we move beyond static one-shot prediction and reformulate final forgery localization as an adaptive sequential decision-updating process, where the localization map is treated as an intermediate state rather than a fixed output. Rather than producing the final mask via one-shot pixel-wise prediction, our method progressively updates the localization state guided by available evidence, uncertainty, and boundary conditions. Specifically, we first transform mesoscopic traces into compact decision evidence via a lightweight decision evidence projector, and then introduce Evidence-Guided Mamba (EG-Mamba) to perform uncertainty- and boundary-aware state updating. This design allows reliable manipulated and background regions to be preserved, while ambiguous regions are cautiously revised according to the available evidence. Extensive experiments on both conventional and AI-generated manipulation benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Notably, even when trained only on conventional manipulation data, our method brings larger gains on unseen AI-generated forgeries, indicating that progressive decision-updating is especially useful for heterogeneous and hard-to-exhaustively-learn manipulation traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将伪造图像定位重新定义为自适应顺序决策更新过程的方法，通过证据引导的Mamba模型（EG-Mamba）逐步更新定位状态，而非一次性预测，从而有效应对AI生成图像伪造中弱且不均匀的取证痕迹。
AI.motivation: AI生成的图像伪造越来越逼真，固定操纵模式难以描述，且生成模型不断演变，仅依靠大规模训练数据穷尽学习所有伪造外观不切实际。虽然伪造痕迹存在但通常微弱且在不同区域可靠性不均，因此需要同时提取有效取证痕迹并从不完整、模糊的证据中做出可靠决策。
AI.method: 首先通过轻量级决策证据投影器将介观痕迹转化为紧凑的决策证据，然后引入证据引导Mamba（EG-Mamba）执行不确定性和边界感知的状态更新，将定位图视为中间状态而非固定输出，逐步更新定位状态，保留可靠的操纵区域和背景区域，同时根据可用证据谨慎修正模糊区域。
AI.result: 在传统操纵和AI生成操纵基准上的广泛实验验证了方法的有效性。特别地，即使仅使用传统操纵数据训练，该方法在未见过的AI生成伪造上也能带来更大的性能提升，表明渐进式决策更新对异构且难以穷尽学习的操纵痕迹尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式决策更新方法比静态一次性预测更适合处理异质且难以穷尽学习的操控痕迹，尤其在未知AI生成伪造场景下表现突出，为鲁棒伪造定位提供了新的思路。

title: AMTFV: Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification for LLM Self-Correction
summary: Large language models have demonstrated strong mathematical problem-solving capabilities, yet reliably verifying their candidate answers remains challenging. Existing representative methods mainly revise outputs through natural-language reflection or assist verification by directly generating verification programs; the former may not reliably support exact computation, whereas the latter prematurely couples mathematical modeling with low-level implementation. We propose AMTFV (Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification). By introducing Mathematical Tool Flow (MTF) as an interrupt--execute--resume interface, AMTFV decouples verification modeling from concrete execution and supports exact computation through a mathematical toolbox. Specifically, the verification agent first constructs a verification workflow, encodes the mathematical objects and computational intent requiring reliable execution in an MTF request, and sends it to the mathematical toolbox agent. The latter parses the request, generates executable calls, and dispatches them to the backend for exact computation. Tool outputs then support candidate-answer adjudication, answer revision, and verification-workflow revision. We evaluate AMTFV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with seven model configurations from DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini. Experimental results show that AMTFV outperforms the representative baselines evaluated in this study overall; under an individual model configuration, it improves average accuracy over the strongest baseline by up to 8.3 percentage points, with larger gains on samples of medium and high verification complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出AMTFV（智能体数学工具流验证）框架，通过引入"数学工具流"作为中断-执行-恢复接口，将验证建模与具体执行解耦，利用数学工具箱实现精确计算，在五个数学推理数据集和七个模型配置上优于代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽具备数学推理能力，但可靠的答案验证仍具挑战性。现有方法要么通过自然语言反思修订输出（无法支持精确计算），要么直接生成验证程序（过早将数学建模与底层实现耦合），缺乏一个既能保证精确计算又能解耦建模与执行的验证方案。
AI.method: AMTFV引入数学工具流（MTF）作为中断-执行-恢复接口。验证智能体先构建验证工作流，将需要可靠执行的数学对象和计算意图编码为MTF请求并发送给数学工具箱智能体；后者解析请求、生成可执行调用，并分派至后端进行精确计算。工具输出支持候选答案判定、答案修订和验证工作流修订。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek、GPT和Gemini共七个模型配置上，对五个挑战性数学推理数据集进行评估，AMTFV整体优于研究中评估的代表性基线。在单个模型配置下，相比最强基线平均准确率最高提升8.3个百分点，在中等和高验证复杂度的样本上收益更大。
AI.conclusion: AMTFV通过将验证建模与具体执行解耦，同时借助数学工具箱支持精确计算，有效提升了数学推理答案验证的可靠性，尤其在验证复杂度较高的场景下优势显著。

title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents need memory to act consistently over long interactions, yet many systems use additional LLM calls to operate that memory. Generating intermediate records and mediating their retrieval adds recurring token and time costs, while omitted or merged details can obscure the original evidence. We ask whether structured memory access requires generation at all. Zero-Mem introduces \emph{zero-token memory operations}: no step outside final question answering invokes an LLM or consumes LLM input or output tokens; encoder computation is accounted for separately. Zero-Mem preserves original interaction traces as its source of record. It organizes the traces in two complementary ways. An entity--context graph exposes connections across interactions, while a temporal hierarchy preserves conversational locality and session state. For each query, Zero-Mem weighs the two views, retrieves from both, and follows their structure to recover supporting relations or surrounding context. Deterministic calibration first discards conflicting evidence and then keeps the reader's answer grounded in the retrieved traces. Only the final-QA reader invokes an LLM. Across long-memory and long-context question-answering benchmarks, Zero-Mem achieves competitive performance while eliminating LLM calls and LLM-token consumption from memory operations. With the same final-QA reader and context budget, it reduces memory-operation time cost by 57.6\% relative to the fastest compared baseline. Ablations support the contribution of the two views and their query-dependent coordination. Overall, the results show that structured agent memory need not generate an intermediate representation of the past. After peer review, the code and implementation details will be available at \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/TheMoon0815/Zero-mem}.

AI.tldr: Zero-Mem提出了一种零token记忆操作方案，无需在记忆读写过程中调用任何LLM，仅通过实体-上下文图和时序层次结构两种互补视图来组织原始交互痕迹，最终仅由一次最终QA阅读器调用LLM，在长记忆和长上下文问答基准上达到竞争性能，同时将记忆操作的时间成本降低57.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆系统依赖额外的LLM调用来操作记忆（生成中间记录、调解检索），这会带来高昂的token和时间成本，且可能丢失或扭曲原始证据。作者质疑：结构化记忆访问是否真的需要生成过程？
AI.method: Zero-Mem采用零token记忆操作，不进行任何中间生成。它保留原始交互痕迹作为记录来源，并通过两种互补方式组织：实体-上下文图（连接跨交互的实体关系）和时序层次结构（保留会话局部性和状态）。查询时对两种视图进行加权，从两者检索并跟随其结构恢复支持关系和上下文。确定性校准先丢弃冲突证据，再让最终QA阅读器基于检索痕迹生成答案，仅此一步调用LLM。
AI.result: 在长记忆和长上下文问答基准上，Zero-Mem取得了与基线相当的竞争性能，同时彻底消除了记忆操作中的LLM调用和token消耗。在相同最终QA阅读器和上下文预算下，相比最快的基线，记忆操作时间成本降低57.6%。消融实验验证了两种视图及其查询依赖协调机制的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结构化代理记忆不一定需要生成过去的中间表示。通过确定性、零生成的组织和检索方式，Zero-Mem证明了可以用更低的成本和开销实现竞争性的长记忆问答性能，为LLM代理的记忆设计提供了新的方向。

title: MoRAE: Flow-Friendly Self-Supervised Latents for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation must produce motions that are semantically correct, temporally coherent, and physically plausible. A natural approach is to first project motion data into a structured semantic space and then train a generative model within that space. Such a paradigm has been highly successful in image generation through Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), where a frozen self-supervised encoder provides semantic features for diffusion or flow models to learn from. However, direct transfer of such a paradigm to motion space using Motion-JEPA as the frozen encoder fails dramatically. We diagnose this failure geometrically and identify two motion-specific bottlenecks: (1) the JEPA feature space is spectrally ill-conditioned, making the Gaussian-to-data transport unstable; and (2) even with a well-conditioned spectrum, flow residuals tend to align with decoder-sensitive directions, where small latent errors are amplified into large motion artifacts after decoding. Based on these insights, we propose MoRAE. MoRAE addresses the two bottlenecks separately. A compact bottleneck distills the structured JEPA representation while removing weak and redundant directions, bringing the latent spectrum into a transport-stable regime. Motion-coupled training then aligns the retained latent geometry with the decoder, making characteristic flow errors less costly after decoding. With this flow-friendly latent, a standard non-autoregressive Flow-Matching DiT achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoRAE，一种在运动生成中利用表示自编码器（RAE）框架的方法。作者诊断了直接使用Motion-JEPA作为冻结编码器导致失败的几何原因，并提出两个针对性解决方案：紧致瓶颈蒸馏JEPA表示以改善谱条件，以及运动耦合训练使潜在空间与解码器对齐，最终配合标准Flow-Matching DiT实现最先进的文本到运动生成性能。
AI.motivation: 文本到运动生成需要语义正确、时间连贯且物理合理的运动。作者借鉴图像生成中RAE范式（冻结自监督编码器提供语义特征供扩散/流模型学习）的成功经验，但发现直接迁移到运动空间（使用Motion-JEPA作为冻结编码器）会严重失败，因此需要诊断故障原因并提出适配运动空间的解决方案。
AI.method: MoRAE包含两个关键组件：(1) 紧致瓶颈（compact bottleneck）——蒸馏结构化的JEPA表示，去除弱和冗余方向，使潜在空间的谱进入传输稳定（transport-stable）区域；(2) 运动耦合训练（motion-coupled training）——将保留的潜在几何与解码器对齐，使流模型的典型误差在解码后代价更小。最终在该流友好的潜在空间上训练标准的非自回归Flow-Matching DiT。
AI.result: 作者从几何角度诊断出两个运动特有的瓶颈：(1) JEPA特征空间谱条件差（spectrally ill-conditioned），导致高斯到数据的传输不稳定；(2) 即使谱条件良好，流残差倾向于与解码器敏感方向对齐，小的潜在误差在解码后被放大为大的运动伪影。提出的MoRAE通过紧致瓶颈和运动耦合训练分别解决这两个问题，使标准Flow-Matching DiT达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从几何视角系统地诊断和解决RAE范式在运动生成中的失败原因，MoRAE证明了一个流友好的潜在空间设计可以让标准的生成模型架构在文本到运动生成任务上取得最先进的结果，为运动生成中潜在表示的设计提供了新的洞察。

title: COntExt: Towards Context-Aware Ontology Extension from Operational Metrics
summary: Organizations increasingly define operational metrics in structured, machine-readable formats to monitor systems, processes, and compliance. These metric definitions implicitly encode domain knowledge, such as referencing concepts, properties, and relationships, that often extends what is captured in formal ontologies. Yet the connection between operational metric catalogues and ontological knowledge remains manual, ad-hoc, and labor-intensive. We present COntExt, a framework for context-aware ontology extension that takes structured metric definitions as input and suggests how referenced concepts and properties should be integrated into an existing ontology, utilizing the context of these metrics. The framework defines the extension problem as three sub-tasks: parent class prediction, relation type prediction, and data property assignment. Across four cybersecurity ontologies, we evaluate different algorithms for each task. Our results show that metric-derived context improves the suggestions over ontology-context baselines for relation type prediction and data property assignment. Our work demonstrates that operational metric catalogues are a practical and underexploited source for ontology extension. This work enables organizations to maintain their ontologies at a significantly lower cost than manual engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COntExt框架，利用结构化运营指标定义中的上下文信息来自动扩展本体论知识，通过三个子任务（父类预测、关系类型预测、数据属性分配）将指标引用的概念和属性集成到现有本体中，实验表明在四个网络安全本体上该方法优于传统基准。
AI.motivation: 组织以机器可读格式定义运营指标，这些指标隐含编码了领域知识（如概念、属性和关系），往往超出正式本体所捕获的范围。然而，运营指标目录与本论知识之间的连接目前仍是手动、临时且劳动密集型的，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出COntExt框架，将本体扩展问题分解为三个子任务：父类预测、关系类型预测和数据属性分配。以结构化指标定义为输入，利用指标本身的上下文信息，在四个网络安全本体上评估多种算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，相比仅使用本体上下文的基准方法，指标派生的上下文在关系类型预测和数据属性分配两个任务上显著提升了建议质量。
AI.conclusion: 运营指标目录是本体扩展中实用且未充分开发的宝贵数据源。该工作使组织能够以远低于人工工程的成本维护本体论知识。

title: PTP: Previous-Token Prediction based LLM Inversion for Near-Exact Prompt Reconstruction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by auto-regressively sampling the next token. This inherently leads to a many-to-many mapping between prompts and responses, complicating the task of inferring prompts from observed outputs. Prior work on LLM inversion frames prompt recovery as a semantic reconstruction task. They rely on fine-tuning pretrained sequence-to-sequence models on large external datasets--and requiring access to model weights or logits--to generate semantically plausible prompts. In contrast, we present a functional approach to inverting a given LLM in a black-box setting, without auxiliary aids. We train an explicit inverse language model entirely from scratch on data synthetically generated from the target LLM itself. Analogous to forward next-token prediction, our inverse model is trained using previous-token prediction, establishing a generative link between the forward and inverse processes that enables faithful prompt reconstruction. Moreover, it naturally supports diverse prompt reconstructions through sampling, whereby all such prompts induce similar responses under the forward, target LLM. Our approach generalises across datasets and exhibits transferability in reconstructing prompts from responses generated by different LLMs. Further, across the set of token based evaluation metrics for prompt and response reconstructions, our approach outperforms prior work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种黑盒场景下的LLM逆向方法，从目标LLM自身生成的合成数据上从头训练一个显式逆向语言模型，通过前向/逆向生成过程的对称性实现提示词的高保真重建。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型自回归生成导致提示词与响应之间存在多对多映射，从观测输出中推断提示词十分困难。现有逆向方法依赖微调预训练序列到序列模型，需要访问模型权重或logits，且依赖大规模外部数据集。
AI.method: 提出一种功能性的黑盒逆向方法，无需任何辅助手段。仅使用目标LLM自身合成的数据从头训练一个显式逆向语言模型，采用前一个token预测（previous-token prediction）进行训练，与正向下一个token预测形成对称的生成过程。通过采样可自然地支持多样化的提示词重建，且重建的提示词在前向目标LLM下能产生相似响应。
AI.result: 该方法在不同数据集上均表现良好，并且具有跨不同LLM的重建迁移能力。在基于token的提示词和响应重建评估指标上，该方法优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立前向与逆向过程的生成性对称连接，在完全黑盒且无外部辅助的条件下实现了更优的提示词重建性能，同时支持多样化的、等价的重建结果。

title: Locally Consistent Transductive Information Maximization for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is increasingly relying on foundation models pre-trained on large-scale Earth-observation data. Moreover, transductive inference, which exploits the collective statistical structure of the entire unlabeled query set, appears to naturally match remote sensing pipelines where large images are routinely split into patches and inferred as a batch. In this work, we introduce LC-TIM (Locally Consistent Transductive Information Maximization), which extends the state-of-the-art Transductive Information Maximization for Few-Shot CLIP (TIM++) objective with a local consistency regularizer that enforces prediction agreement between each query sample and its $κ$ nearest feature-space neighbors. The regularizer enters as a single multiplicative factor in the closed-form $q$-update, adding negligible computational overhead. We further propose a multi-source extension that fuses the affinity graph from multiple remote sensing foundation model, further boosting classification accuracy. To assess these methods, we establish the first comprehensive, open-source benchmark for transductive few-shot RS scene classification, evaluating LP++, TransCLIP, TIM++, and LC-TIM across ten diverse datasets, two remote sensing vision-language models, and across various few-shot settings. Our experiments show that transductive methods consistently outperform zero-shot baselines, and that LC-TIM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, with the largest gains in the low-shot regime where neighborhood cues are most informative. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/elkhouryk/LC-TIM

title: LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning from Preference Feedback
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) systems are typically trained using a single, well-specified scalar reward function. However, real-world decision-making tasks often involve multiple, competing objectives, such as performance versus efficiency, where ground-truth reward functions are difficult to specify or inaccessible. While Multi-Objective RL (MORL) addresses such trade-offs by modeling rewards as vectors, existing approaches typically assume access to a well-specified reward function for each objective, inheriting the same challenges faced by single-objective RL. Meanwhile, Preference-based RL (PbRL) has shown great potential in solving complex tasks without access to a pre-defined reward function through reward learning from human feedback, yet has largely been studied in single-objective settings. In this work, we bridge this gap with LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Preference feedback, a novel framework where an agent interactively learns from the preferences of multiple humans to learn optimal multi-objective policies. Our approach jointly learns policies and multiple objective-specific reward models from human feedback, enabling agents to effectively balance competing objectives during learning. We evaluate LEMUR on a variety of benchmark multi-objective tasks, and empirical results demonstrate its superior performance over baseline methods. Our method presents a promising direction for solving multi-objective decision-making tasks without pre-defined reward functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEMUR框架，将偏好强化学习(PbRL)与多目标强化学习(MORL)相结合，通过多个人类偏好反馈同时学习策略和多个目标特定的奖励模型，从而在无需预定义奖励函数的情况下解决多目标决策任务。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的决策任务通常涉及多个相互竞争的优化目标，但现有MORL方法假设每个目标都有明确定义的奖励函数，而PbRL虽然在单目标设置下取得了成功，却未在MORL中得到充分探索。因此需要一种无需预定义奖励函数的多目标强化学习方法。
AI.method: LEMUR框架通过从多个人类偏好反馈中联合学习策略和多个目标特定的奖励模型，使智能体在交互学习过程中能够有效平衡竞争目标。
AI.result: 在多种基准多目标任务上的实验结果表明，LEMUR的性能优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LEMUR为无需预定义奖励函数的多目标决策任务提供了一种有前景的解决方案，弥合了PbRL与MORL之间的研究空白。

title: Studying quantization trade-offs for efficient inference deployment in machine translation
summary: Deploying large language models in realistic server environments poses challenges, as the system needs to provide high-quality responses with low latency. Quantization is a common approach to reduce the memory footprint and improve inference efficiency, yet its impact on latency and throughput is rarely evaluated under controlled, orchestration-level workloads. In this work we study the quantization trade-offs of two translation model families, EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} and Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} across five models ranging from 1.7B to 22B for efficient deployment on a single A100 or H100 GPU. We demonstrate that combining a document-chunking strategy with W4A8 or W8A8 quantization improves the latency-throughput Pareto-curve under a wide range of workloads. Furthermore, since standard machine translation (MT) benchmarks rely on isolated sentences and fail to capture long-context dynamics, we introduce a document-level evaluation from WMT24++ to assess how text chunking strategies affect translation quality under quantization. Our results reveal that standard segment-level evaluation can fail to predict the interaction between quantization and long-context document translation. While Hy-MT2 remains robust under quantization, EuroLLM shows strong sensitivity and translation quality collapses rapidly for all considered quantization formats. Overall, our experiments show that the trade-off between inference efficiency and translation quality depends not only on the quantization format, but also on the choice of text chunking strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了EuroLLM和Hy-MT2两个翻译模型系列（1.7B至22B）在A100/H100 GPU上的量化权衡，发现将文档分块策略与W4A8或W8A8量化结合可改善时延-吞吐量帕累托曲线，并引入WMT24++文档级评估来揭示量化与长上下文翻译的交互效应。结果显示Hy-MT2对量化稳健，而EuroLLM对量化高度敏感，翻译质量迅速下降。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏在可控的编排级工作负载下对量化对时延和吞吐量影响的评估，且标准MT基准只使用孤立句子，无法捕捉长上下文动态，导致量化与文档翻译质量的交互效应被忽视。
AI.method: 在单张A100或H100 GPU上对五个不同规模的EuroLLM和Hy-MT2模型进行W4A8和W8A8量化实验，结合文档分块策略评估量化的时延-吞吐量权衡，并引入WMT24++文档级评估来检验分块策略对翻译质量的影响。
AI.result: 文档分块与W4A8/W8A8量化结合能改善时延-吞吐量帕累托曲线；Hy-MT2在量化下保持稳健，而EuroLLM对量化敏感，所有量化格式下翻译质量均快速崩溃；标准段级评估无法预测量化与长上下文文档翻译的交互。
AI.conclusion: 推理效率与翻译质量的权衡不仅取决于量化格式，还取决于文本分块策略的选择。研究强调了在真实部署环境中需要结合长上下文文档级评估来全面衡量量化影响的重要性。

title: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
summary: Games and simulators make valuable benchmarks by turning decisions into measurable outcomes, but many current suites under-test rules-rich tactical reasoning: the ability to choose well when geometry, timing, resources, objectives, and rule interactions all matter at once. We introduce DungeonBench, a benchmark for tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat, built to cover the vast majority of combat-relevant 2014 System Reference Document content whose effects can be resolved by the simulator while retaining mechanics that simplified combat simulators often abstract away. At each step, DungeonBench exposes a complete tactical observation, a pending decision, and an indexed list of executable options spanning movement, attacks, spells, reactions, objectives, preparation, and scarce resources. The task is to value legal choices whose consequences depend on action economy, creature traits, battlefield geometry, timing windows, and future encounters. DungeonBench has two tracks: Encounter, which evaluates local tactical play in single fights, and Day, which links encounters through persistent hit points, spell slots, consumables, preparation, and short-rest timing, forcing policies to trade off immediate tactical advantage against future survivability. The same engine-generated decision stream supports heuristic controllers, language-model policies, learned option rankers, and masked-action reinforcement-learning agents. We evaluate frontier language-model policies on this shared decision stream. Results show that full tactical observations do not saturate the benchmark: frontier policies often win direct encounters, but linked encounter days expose failures in resource budgeting, rest timing, and rule-aware tactical discipline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DungeonBench，一个基于D&D第5版战斗系统的战术推理基准，包含单场遭遇战和连续作战日两个轨道，用于评估语言模型等策略在复杂规则环境下的战术决策与资源管理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏/模拟器基准大多未充分测试规则密集型的战术推理能力——即在几何、时机、资源、目标和规则交互同时起作用时做出良好决策的能力。
AI.method: 基于2014版SRD内容构建D&D战斗模拟器基准，覆盖绝大部分可解析的战斗相关规则，提供完整战术观测、待定决策和可执行选项列表；包含Encounter（单场战斗）和Day（多场连续战斗）两个轨道，支持启发式、语言模型、学习型排序器和掩码动作强化学习等多种策略。
AI.result: 对前沿语言模型策略的评测表明，完整战术观测并未使基准饱和：模型在直接遭遇战中常能获胜，但在连续作战日轨道中暴露出资源预算、休息时机和规则感知战术纪律方面的失败。
AI.conclusion: DungeonBench有效区分了不同策略的战术推理能力，揭示了现有前沿模型在跨遭遇战的长期资源管理方面的明显不足，为战术推理研究提供了更具挑战性的评测平台。

title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents evolve into personalized companions, memory has emerged as a core capability. However, LLMs face a knowledge utilization problem: they may fail to act on relevant user preferences even when they are fully present in context. When an agent fails to tailor its response in a context where previously shared user preferences should matter, it is unclear whether the model failed to remember that information or remembered it but failed to use it. To isolate this breakdown, we introduce a decoupled evaluation paradigm that administers paired Know and Act tests to the same user preference. We conduct large-scale experiments across 16 systems and five memory architectures, evaluating 1,000 preferences embedded at three levels of expression strength. Our results show a large gap between Know and Act outcomes: agents often pass the recall test for a user preference but fail to reflect that same preference in the paired behavioral scenario. While memory architectures reduce this gap, utilization remains especially weak for health and therapy-related preferences, where failures to act carry the greatest real-world stakes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解耦评估范式，将LLM代理的"知识获取"（Know）与"知识使用"（Act）分离测试，发现代理虽然能记住用户偏好，但常常在行为场景中未能应用这些偏好，尤其在健康和治疗相关偏好上表现最弱。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在拥有用户偏好信息时仍可能无法据此定制响应，但无法判断是"没记住"还是"记住了但没用"。这种知识利用失败的根源归属问题亟需解决。
AI.method: 引入解耦评估范式，对同一用户偏好设计配对的Know测试（召回）和Act测试（行为应用）；在16个系统和5种记忆架构上进行大规模实验，评估1,000个偏好并嵌入三个表达强度级别。
AI.result: Know与Act结果之间存在显著差距：代理在偏好召回测试中经常通过，却在配对的行为场景中未能体现该偏好。记忆架构虽能缩小这一差距，但健康与治疗相关偏好的利用能力仍然非常薄弱。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理的主要问题不在于记忆缺失，而在于知识利用不足；记忆架构只能部分缓解该问题，高风险的医疗健康领域偏好利用仍然是最严峻的挑战。

title: Domain-Division based Progressive Learning for Source-Free Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 2025
summary: With growing privacy and portability concerns, source-free domain adaptation requires only a source pre-trained model and an unlabeled target domain, allowing for effective adaptation to the target data. Most existing self-training methods focus on selecting and exploiting samples with reliable predictions, often neglecting others. Inspired by the finding that deep models learn clean samples faster than noisy ones, we propose a domain-division based progressive learning method named DPL. Specifically, our approach consists of two alternating stages, each beginning with the division of the target domain into easy-to-adapt and hard-to-adapt subdomains based on adaptation difficulty, followed by neighborhood-based pseudo label assignment. In stage one, we enhance classification accuracy through uncertainty-aware self-training and alignment of corresponding classes between subdomains. Stage two then applies tailored learning strategies to each subdomain, starting with consistency learning on the easy-to-adapt samples and progressing to utilizing local structural information for the more challenging ones, thereby mining the intrinsic properties of the target data. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/iamjingli/DPL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于域划分的渐进学习方法（DPL），用于源自由域适应（SFDA），通过将目标域划分为易适应和难适应子域，并采用不同的学习策略进行逐步适应，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的大多数源自由域适应方法主要关注预测可靠的样本，忽略了其他样本；同时深度模型学习干净样本的速度快于噪声样本这一发现被忽视，未能充分利用目标域数据的内在结构信息。
AI.method: 提出DPL方法，包含两个交替阶段：每个阶段首先根据适应难度将目标域划分为易适应和难适应子域，然后进行基于邻域的伪标签分配。阶段一通过不确定性感知的自训练和子域间类别对齐提升分类精度；阶段二对每个子域采用定制学习策略，先对易适应样本进行一致性学习，再利用局部结构信息处理难适应样本。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的基准数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了方法的有效性，性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过域划分和渐进学习的策略，能够有效挖掘目标数据的内在属性，提升源自由域适应的性能，代码已公开。

title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
summary: As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on static code generation, paper replication, or final answer correctness, but do not directly assess whether agents can interpret experimental evidence and use it to guide subsequent hyperparameter decisions. To address this gap, we introduce AgentHPOBench, a sequential benchmark comprising 30 executable machine learning tasks across seven research categories. Each task begins with a validated baseline run, after which an agent performs several sequential interventions. At each step, the agent observes the accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs before proposing the next valid configuration. We evaluate 12 widely used agents and conventional HPO baselines under a unified protocol. The results show that current agents exhibit measurable experimental optimization ability across domains, but still face clear limitations in sustained iterative refinement, complex log diagnosis, and consistent progress toward reported reference performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AgentHPOBench，一个包含30个可执行机器学习任务的顺序基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体在实验场景中基于证据进行超参数决策的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要关注静态代码生成、论文复现或最终答案正确性，无法直接评估智能体是否能解读实验证据并据此指导后续超参数决策，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建包含30个可执行机器学习任务、覆盖7个研究类别的顺序基准，每个任务从验证过的基线运行开始，智能体执行多次顺序干预，每一步观察累积配置、指标和日志后提出下一个有效配置；在统一协议下评估12种主流智能体和传统HPO基线。
AI.result: 当前智能体在不同领域表现出可测量的实验优化能力，但在持续迭代改进、复杂日志诊断以及向参考性能稳定进展方面仍存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM智能体具备一定的实验优化能力但尚未成熟，在需要多轮迭代和深层日志理解的场景中仍需要进一步提升。

title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
summary: Interventional data is widely regarded as the gold standard for teaching models causal reasoning. We test this assumption in a fully controlled synthetic environment pitting observational correlation against causal effect, and find it fails instructively. In Simpson's-paradox worlds, where the two have systematically opposite signs, increasing the fraction of interventional samples in pretraining does not improve causal direction: the magnitude of the model's do()-response grows monotonically, yet its sign is copied from the observational context. What governs whether interventional evidence is used is not the training mixture but the evidence type present in the context at inference time. Under an identical training recipe, a purely observational context induces systematic sign reversal in 29/50 worlds, a mixed context in 19/50, while aligned interventional probes alone yield 41/50 correct. Erasing observational evidence from the context immediately releases the suppressed causal interpolation ability (ratio_true = +0.56); a four-state content manipulation shows the switch is content-mediated and graded. The suppression is stable across training seeds (11/11 strong reversals persist on a matched-protocol second seed) and robust as a rate at 0.93B parameters (31.8% vs. 6% reversals in the matched probe-only arm), even as absolute gains shrink four-fold. An external audit on CLadder exposes a learned positive-effect prior with a two-layer structure: sign-randomized retraining removes it in-distribution but not out-of-distribution. We summarize: the capability lives in the weights; the switch lives in the context, and activation patching localizes the switch to the middle layers' observational rows. We further quantify the sampling noise floor of probe-based causal evaluation and an evidence-averaging protocol that cuts sign errors from 26% to 9%.

AI.tldr: 本文在完全受控的合成环境中检验"干预数据是教模型因果推理的金标准"这一假设，发现该假设存在严重缺陷。在辛普森悖论世界中，干预样本比例增加不会改善因果方向判断——模型的do()响应幅度单调增长，但符号却复制自观测上下文。因果证据是否被使用取决于推理时上下文中的证据类型而非训练混合比例。通过消融实验、激活修补和外部审计，揭示了"能力在权重中，开关在上下文中"的核心机制。
AI.motivation: 挑战"干预数据是训练因果推理模型的最佳方式"这一广泛假设。已有工作认为增加干预数据比例能提升模型的因果推理能力，但本文在合成环境中系统性地测试了这一假设，发现其并不成立，并进一步探究了失效的机制。
AI.method: 在辛普森悖论构造的合成环境中，通过系统改变训练数据中干预样本的比例和推理时的上下文证据类型（纯观测、混合、纯干预），测试模型do()响应行为。利用消融实验（去除上下文观测证据）、四状态内容操控、跨种子和参数规模验证、外部CLadder审计、激活修补以及证据平均化协议等方法。
AI.result: 干预样本比例增加仅增大响应幅度不改变符号；纯观测上下文导致29/50世界符号反转，混合上下文19/50，纯干预探针41/50正确；去除观测证据立即释放被抑制的因果插值能力；抑制跨种子稳定且在小规模模型中也存在；外部审计发现两层结构的正效应先验；激活修补定位开关在中层观测行。
AI.conclusion: 模型确实具备因果插值能力（存于权重中），但其是否被使用由推理时上下文中是否存在观测证据决定（开关在上下文中）。这挑战了单纯增加干预数据比例能提升因果推理的主流做法，指出了评估协议和训练策略需要重新设计。

title: Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification with Dual Semantic Guidance and Global-Local Mutual Modulation
comment: Accepted by IEEE TCSVT 2026. The version of record may differ slightly
summary: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve target instances by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, existing methods suffer from two challenges. First, they often fail to exploit well-aligned and reliable semantic priors, making them vulnerable to background clutter and cross-modal misalignment. On the other hand, they typically rely on holistic feature modeling, overlooking the synergy between global and local representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a robust multi-modal ReID framework with dual semantic guidance and global-local mutual modulation, which mainly consists of three key components, namely the Text-Semantic Injector (TSI), the Masked Global-Local Modulator (MGLM), and the Hierarchical MoE Fusion (HMF). The TSI enhances semantic awareness by integrating clean and coherent textual features into visual tokens. The MGLM enables part-aware cross-modal interaction through joint guidance from soft masks and global context, improving fine-grained feature alignment. Finally, the HMF adaptively aggregates multi-spectral features under local semantic supervision, yielding discriminative and robust representations. Extensive experiments on three multi-modal ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zw-absin/DSGM upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的多模态目标重识别（ReID）框架，通过双重语义引导和全局-局部互调制来解决现有方法在语义先验利用不足和全局-局部特征协同缺失方面的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态ReID方法存在两个主要挑战：一是未能充分利用对齐且可靠的语义先验，容易受背景干扰和跨模态错位影响；二是依赖整体特征建模，忽视了全局与局部表征之间的协同作用。
AI.method: 提出三个关键组件：（1）文本语义注入器（TSI）——将清晰连贯的文本特征整合到视觉token中增强语义感知；（2）掩码全局-局部调制器（MGLM）——通过软掩码与全局上下文联合引导实现部分感知的跨模态交互；（3）层次化专家混合融合（HMF）——在局部语义监督下自适应聚合多光谱特征。
AI.result: 在三个多模态ReID基准数据集上进行了大量实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的DSGM框架通过语义引导与全局-局部调制有效提升了多模态ReID的判别性和鲁棒性，代码将在论文接收后公开。

title: Development of FDD-ON: an Ontology for VAV HVAC System Fault Detection and Diagnostics
summary: Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) technology is essential for improving HVAC system reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness. However, effective deployment of FDD solutions in buildings requires structured domain knowledge that can bridge heterogeneous data sources, diverse equipment types, and varied diagnostic outputs. Limited data interpretability and interoperability within the FDD domain have led to fragmented information silos, hindering the implementation of FDD and related applications, such as the digital twin-enabled FDD frameworks and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven maintenance decision-making systems. This paper presents an FDD Ontology (FDD-ON), a modular and extensible ontology to formally represent variable air volume (VAV) HVAC system components, fault types, symptom statuses, fault impacts and associated attributes. FDD-ON integrates HVAC system FDD semantics to provide comprehensive representations of fault and symptom attributes, supported by the well-defined controlled vocabulary. Additionally, FDD-ON offers comprehensive fault, symptom, and impact libraries to capture a broad spectrum of operational abnormalities and their consequences in VAV HVAC systems. Through explicit contributing cause-fault-symptom-impact relations, FDD-ON serves as a machine-interpretable basis for querying diagnostic knowledge, mapping heterogeneous FDD outputs, and developing interoperable FDD-related applications. FDD-ON is evaluated using publicly available VAV HVAC system datasets and demonstrated through FDD development applications. Results indicate that FDD-ON provides a foundational semantic framework for advancing scalable, transparent, and interoperable FDD solutions across various applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FDD-ON，一个模块化、可扩展的故障检测与诊断（FDD）本体，用于正式表示VAV HVAC系统组件、故障类型、症状状态、故障影响及相关属性，通过明确的原因-故障-症状-影响关系实现机器可解释的诊断知识查询和异构FDD输出的互操作。
AI.motivation: HVAC系统的FDD技术对提升可靠性和能效至关重要，但FDD领域缺乏结构化的领域知识来桥接异构数据源、多样设备类型和不同诊断输出，导致信息孤岛，阻碍了FDD应用及数字孪生和AI驱动的维护决策系统的发展。
AI.method: 提出了FDD-ON本体，采用模块化可扩展架构正式表示VAV HVAC系统组件、故障类型、症状状态、故障影响及属性；集成了FDD语义和受控词汇表，提供全面的故障、症状和影响库，通过贡献原因-故障-症状-影响关系支持诊断知识查询和异构输出映射。
AI.result: 使用公开可用的VAV HVAC系统数据集对FDD-ON进行评估，并通过FDD开发应用进行验证。结果表明FDD-ON为推进可扩展、透明和可互操作的FDD解决方案提供了基础语义框架。
AI.conclusion: FDD-ON作为VAV HVAC系统FDD领域的语义基础框架，能够有效支持跨应用的FDD开发，提升诊断知识的透明性、可扩展性和互操作性，为数字孪生和AI驱动的维护决策提供了语义支撑。

title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
summary: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText) and four open-weight generators (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B). Each source item yields four matched variants: human-written (HUMAN), direct LLM generation (Free-LLM), LLM-rewritten human text (H2L), and same-generator LLM-rewritten LLM text (LLM2L). We evaluated five detectors (FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, RoBERTa-Defense) at a strict 1%-false-positive operating point (TPR@1%FPR). FastDetectGPT and Binoculars-falcon-7b detected 91.2% and 93.5\% of direct LLM text, but only 30.8% and 15.1% of human text an LLM had rewritten, a drop of 60-78 percentage points. The same detectors retained 78.3% and 83.0% recall when LLM text was rewritten by the same model, a much smaller decline of 10-13 points. RADAR followed the same pattern (66.8% to 12.2%), while BERT-Defense and RoBERTa-Defense stayed below 3% recall across all regimes. These results show that detector performance measured on the conventional human-vs-LLM benchmark does not transfer to human-authored text revised by an LLM, even though the same detectors remain largely robust to LLM-only rewriting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB)，一个包含1,800篇人类源文本和四种LLM生成器的基准数据集，用于评估AI文本检测器在LLM改写人类文本场景下的表现。实验发现，传统基准上表现良好的检测器（如FastDetectGPT和Binoculars）在检测LLM改写的人类文本时性能暴跌60-78个百分点，但检测LLM自身改写的文本时仅下降10-13个百分点，表明传统基准无法预测检测器在人类文本被LLM改写场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测基准仅比较人类直接写作与LLM直接生成的文本，忽略了人类文本被LLM改写的现实场景。之前的研究虽表明改写会降低检测性能，但传统基准能否预测这种场景下的检测行为仍然未知。
AI.method: 构建ARB基准数据集，包含1,800个人类源文本（来自XSum、WritingPrompts、OpenWebText各600个），使用四种开放权重生成器（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）生成四种匹配变体：人类原文、LLM直接生成、LLM改写的人类文本（H2L）、同生成器LLM改写LLM文本（LLM2L），并在1%假阳性率下评估五个检测器（FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense）。
AI.result: FastDetectGPT和Binoculars-falcon-7b在检测LLM直接生成文本时分别达到91.2%和93.5%的召回率，但检测LLM改写的人类文本时骤降至30.8%和15.1%，下降了60-78个百分点。同一检测器在检测同模型改写的LLM文本时仅下降10-13个百分点。RADAR表现出类似模式（从66.8%降至12.2%），而BERT-Defense和RoBERTa-Defense在所有场景下召回率均低于3%。
AI.conclusion: 传统基准上检测器的性能无法迁移到LLM改写人类文本的场景，检测器对LLM-only改写仍相对稳健（性能下降较小），但对人类文本被LLM改写的情况极度脆弱。这揭示了当前AI文本检测评估体系的一个重大盲区，需要开发新的检测方法和基准来应对LLM改写的现实威胁。

title: Sycophancy Undermines Epistemic Vigilance in Cooperative Vision-Language Tasks
summary: To maintain common ground in cooperative conversation, humans iteratively update their beliefs as conversation participants share new information; participants who are epistemically vigilant detect when new information conflicts with prior beliefs and take steps to repair these conflicts. In order for AI systems to serve as reliable partners in complex cooperative tasks, they must similarly weigh incoming information against their own private evidence and shared context and appropriately surface inconsistencies when they arise. To measure the epistemic vigilance of vision-language models in cooperative settings, we present an information-asymmetric, dialog-based "spot-the-difference" task. Two models are privately shown one image each, and must determine through conversation whether the images are identical or, if not, identify the difference. Models routinely fail at this: they frequently overlook key evidence in their private image in favor of agreeing with their conversational partner, even when their agreement is unwarranted. We relate these violations of epistemic vigilance to the broader behavior of sycophancy, which manifests itself in cooperative goal-oriented dialog as over-accommodation and weak evidential grounding. Our results show that model steering to reduce sycophancy with a vector learned from task-agnostic sycophancy examples can reduce epistemic vigilance-related errors, making models more faithful reporters of their evidence, and in turn, more reliable partners in information-asymmetric cooperative tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个信息不对称的对话式"找不同"任务，用于衡量视觉语言模型在合作场景中的"认知警觉性"（epistemic vigilance）。研究发现模型经常忽视自己私有图像中的关键证据而过度迎合对话伙伴，并证明通过任务无关的谄媚（sycophancy）示例学习到的方向向量进行模型引导，可以减少这类认知警觉性错误，使模型成为更可靠的信息不对称合作任务伙伴。
AI.motivation: 人类在合作对话中会不断更新信念并对新信息保持认知警觉，发现冲突时主动修复。AI系统要成为复杂合作任务的可靠伙伴，同样需要权衡输入信息与自身私有证据及共享语境，并恰当暴露不一致。然而现有研究缺乏衡量视觉语言模型在合作场景中认知警觉性的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一个信息不对称的对话式"找不同"任务：两个模型各自私下看到一张图片，通过对话判断图片是否相同，若不同则找出差异。在该设置下测试模型的认知警觉性，并将违反认知警觉性的行为与谄媚（sycophancy）行为联系起来，即表现为过度迁就和弱的证据基础。随后使用从任务无关的谄媚示例中学习到的向量对模型进行引导（steering）以减少谄媚行为。
AI.result: 模型在该任务中经常失败：倾向于忽视私有图像中的关键证据而同意对话伙伴，即使这种一致是没有根据的。通过任务无关谄媚示例学习的方向向量进行模型引导，可以有效减少认知警觉性相关错误，使模型更忠实地报告其证据。
AI.conclusion: 模型在信息不对称合作任务中的认知警觉性不足是谄媚行为的一种表现。通过向量引导减少谄媚可以提升模型的证据忠实度和可靠性，使其成为更好的合作任务伙伴。

title: CorrelationFlow: A Training-Free Geometric Approach for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
summary: LiDAR scene flow estimation has settled into a monoculture: nearly all recent methods share the same feed-forward architecture and the same family of self-supervised losses, inheriting each other's assumptions, and each other's blind spots. When those assumptions fail, as they do for sparse, distant, or fast-moving objects, every method built on them fails together, and adding parameters or simulated training data does not fix what the formulation itself gets wrong. This paper takes the opposite path. We present CorrelationFlow, a training-free geometric framework that reduces scene flow to two textbook operations: connected-component labeling and correlation maximization on bird's-eye-view occupancy images. Objects are isolated as spatio-temporal connected components, their motions recovered as correlation peaks, and the resulting velocities propagated to all member points. However, this dense correlation evaluates every candidate displacement of every cluster and requires a window of past sweeps; therefore, we develop a sparse counterpart that operates on a single sweep pair by matching lightweight occupancy descriptors at boundary key points. Because nothing is trained, nothing is inherited: on the multi-domain test set of the Argoverse 2 2026 Scene Flow Challenge, spanning five datasets with heterogeneous sensors and platforms, CorrelationFlow ranked second among unsupervised methods and degrades most gracefully at long range, where the shared assumptions of learned methods break down. Our results suggest that a substantial share of the scene flow problem is solvable by classical computer vision, and that progress may require questioning the formulation, not scaling it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CorrelationFlow，一个无需训练的几何框架，通过连通分量标记和相关性最大化两个经典操作解决LiDAR场景流估计问题。在Argoverse 2 2026场景流挑战赛多域测试集上，该方法在无监督方法中排名第二，且在长距离场景下退化最优雅，表明经典计算机视觉方法仍能解决大量场景流问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LiDAR场景流估计方法高度同质化，几乎所有最新方法都共享相同的前馈架构和自监督损失族，相互继承假设和盲点。当这些假设在稀疏、遥远或快速移动物体上失败时，所有方法同时失效，增加参数或模拟训练数据也无法修复公式本身的问题。本文旨在跳出这一"单一文化"，探索经典计算机视觉方法的潜力。
AI.method: CorrelationFlow采用训练自由的两步经典操作：(1) 通过时空连通分量标记在鸟瞰视图占用图像上分离物体；(2) 通过相关性最大化恢复物体运动，并将速度传播到所有成员点。同时，为克服密集相关计算需要多帧历史扫描的局限，开发了稀疏版本——在单次扫描对上通过匹配边界关键点的轻量级占用描述符来估计运动。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2 2026场景流挑战赛的多域测试集上（涵盖五个异构传感器和平台的数据集），CorrelationFlow在无监督方法中排名第二，并且在长距离场景中退化最为优雅——这正是学习型方法共享假设失效的区域。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，场景流问题的很大一部分可以通过经典计算机视觉方法解决，领域进步可能需要对公式本身提出质疑，而非单纯扩大模型规模。

title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this observation, we propose ResKV, which divides a fixed KV budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that reconstructs the contribution of omitted tokens. ResKV lets main-cache tokens and residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization, so residual entries restore both attention numerator and denominator mass rather than acting as a post-hoc correction. A construction-time validation proxy determines residual allocation for each layer and KV head, while a decode-time dynamic gate adjusts residual contributions for individual queries. Comprehensive evaluations on LongBench and RULER, covering query-aware and query-agnostic settings, multiple backbones, cache budgets, and representative compression baselines, demonstrate broad improvements under the same retained KV budget while preserving the practical efficiency of compressed decoding, including peak memory usage and long-context decode throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResKV，一种KV缓存压缩方法，将固定KV预算分为精确主缓存和紧凑残差缓存，通过重建被逐出token的注意力贡献来提升长上下文推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的KV缓存压缩方法中，逐出法会永久丢弃未选中的token从而损失其注意力聚合贡献，而合并法虽保留更多信息但会扰动需要精确的键值。作者观察到缓存逐出所遗漏的信息可以表示为softmax注意力分子和分母中的残差统计量，以此为契机提出ResKV。
AI.method: ResKV将固定KV预算分为精确主缓存和紧凑残差缓存，残差缓存重建被遗漏token的贡献。主缓存token和残差条目参与相同的softmax归一化，从而同时恢复注意力的分子和分母质量而非事后校正。构建时通过验证代理确定每层和每个KV头的残差分配，解码时通过动态门控调整每个查询的残差贡献。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER上的综合评估涵盖了query-aware和query-agnostic设置、多个主干网络、缓存预算及代表性压缩基线，结果表明在相同保留KV预算下具有广泛改进，同时保持了压缩解码的实际效率，包括峰值内存使用和长上下文解码吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: ResKV通过残差缓存重建逐出token的注意力贡献，在保持压缩解码效率的前提下，显著提升了KV缓存压缩的性能。

title: When Model Priors Conflict with Visual Evidence: Mitigating Commonsense-Driven Hallucinations by Selective Prior Calibration
summary: In vision--language models, commonsense-driven hallucination (CDH) occurs when a model's commonsense prior overrides clear visual evidence of an atypical state. For example, a model may report that a visibly six-fingered hand has five fingers. We show that these errors are systematically directed: when a model answers a question about a counterfactual (CF) image incorrectly, its answer often coincides with the candidate it prefers without access to the image. Suppressing this prior indiscriminately can repair CF errors, but may also disrupt correct answers on matched commonsense (CS) images, where the same prior is helpful. We therefore propose Selective Prior Calibration (SPC), which subtracts candidate-level prior-preference estimates from image-conditioned scores with an instance-dependent strength and revises the original prediction only when the resulting score pattern strongly supports an alternative. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPC substantially improves accuracy on CF images while largely preserving accuracy on matched CS images. Furthermore, these gains generalize across CDH categories, candidate-answer permutations, and other conflict benchmarks, while SPC rarely alters predictions on benchmarks without such conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉-语言模型中的常识驱动幻觉（CDH）问题，提出选择性先验校准（SPC）方法，通过实例相关的强度从图像条件得分中减去候选级先验偏好估计，在修正反事实图像的错误预测的同时，保持对匹配常识图像的正确预测，实验证明该方法在多种基准上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型中存在常识驱动幻觉问题，即模型的常识先验会压倒清晰的视觉证据，导致对非典型状态（如六指手）的错误判断。仅盲目抑制先验虽能修复反事实图像错误，但会破坏常识图像的正确回答，因此需要选择性校准。
AI.method: 提出选择性先验校准（SPC）方法：1）计算候选级别的先验偏好估计（无图像条件下的偏好）；2）从图像条件得分中减去该先验估计，并采用实例相关的强度进行校准；3）仅当结果得分模式强烈支持替代答案时才修订原始预测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SPC显著提升反事实图像上的准确率，同时基本保持匹配常识图像的准确率；该增益可泛化到不同CDH类别、候选答案排列及其他冲突基准，且在无冲突基准上几乎不改变预测。
AI.conclusion: SPC提供了一种精准的、选择性的先验校准策略，既能有效缓解视觉-语言模型中的常识驱动幻觉，又不会损害模型在正常场景下的表现，具有较强的泛化性和安全性。

title: Evolving language compositionality in a frequency-structured meaning space
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures (plus 2 figures in appendix), submitted to Wivace 2026 (https://sites.google.com/cam.ac.uk/wivace26)
summary: The iterated learning model was introduced to investigate language evolution: the way in which the characteristic properties of human languages have been shaped, at least partly, by repeated transmission from one language user to another. The key finding is that language compositionality can arise spontaneously as a consequence of language being passed repeatedly through a language learning bottleneck. Here we explore how changing the frequency of different meanings, so that some meanings occur much more frequently than others, affects the character of its compositionality. We find that, as observed in natural languages, high-frequency meanings can escape the pressure to conform to the grammar that characterizes lower-frequency meanings. However, when the frequency structure is instead imposed on parts rather than on whole meaning vectors, the language fails to transmit across generations. This occurs despite the fact that the most frequent elements are reliably learned. These results suggest that frequency can shape emergent linguistic structure only when the frequency distribution is defined over form-meaning units that learners can acquire holistically. When frequency is instead distributed over smaller units, it fails to support the relational structure required for compositional generalisation, thereby preventing stable language transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文通过迭代学习模型探讨了意义使用频率如何影响语言组合性的演化，发现高频意义可以逃脱语法压力，但频率分布在部分单元上时语言无法跨代传递。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中存在高频词可脱离常规语法模式的现象（如不规则动词），研究者希望通过迭代学习模型探究意义频率分布如何塑造语言组合性的本质特征。
AI.method: 采用迭代学习模型，通过两轮实验操纵频率分布：一种将频率施加于完整意义向量，另一种将频率施加于意义的组成部分（部分单元），观察语言在跨代传递中的演化特征。
AI.result: 当频率施加于完整意义向量时，高频意义可像自然语言那样逃脱语法一致性压力；但当频率施加于意义的较小组成部分时，尽管高频要素能被可靠学习，语言整体却无法跨代稳定传递。
AI.conclusion: 频率只有在定义于学习者能整体习得的形义单元上才能塑造突现的语言结构；当频率分配在更小的单元上时，无法支持组合性泛化所需的关联结构，从而阻碍语言的稳定传播。

title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
summary:
LLM serving systems cache prompt KV state, yet most front ends still re-tokenize the full request text on every call. The cost lands on coding agents, which resubmit a long transcript after each small tool result, and reuse is hard because even a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous sequence. Across 153,951 calls from two agent ecosystems, the median call appends about 1.4K characters, and only 1.0-3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session with contexts of millions of characters. At a 94.1% fleet prompt-cache hit rate, tokenization reaches up to 64% of time to first token.
  TokTier is a stateful tokenization service with one contract: emitted token IDs are always identical to full reference tokenization of the request text. For a session continuation, it re-tokenizes a small window around the append and splices only after a per-request stable-boundary check, widening the window or falling back to full tokenization on failure. For a call without a reusable prefix, it decomposes GPT-family regex pre-tokenization into run-local rules and runs exact pre-tokenization and BPE on a GPU. A sampled shadow verifier re-checks live traffic.
  Across 17 tokenizer families, differential campaigns cover 1.5x10^10 split checks, a 12.4 TB real-text corpus, and 93,000+ replayed agent steps, with zero divergence. Incremental repair takes 0.5-1.1 ms from 100K to 3M characters, up to 437x faster than HF tokenization and 2.1x faster at 1M than the strongest cache-based baseline (Gigatoken) fully prewarmed. GPU full tokenization encodes a 1M-character request in 0.87 ms, up to 491x below HF and 23.4x below the fastest published CPU method. With vLLM, median time to first token drops 16-34% and P99 drops 23% under recorded bursts. Under a 50 ms P99 objective, four repair cores plus one GPU sustain 1,821 requests/s where a 16-core stateless front end saturates at 40.
